12	# DateTimePicker
13	
14	`DateTimePicker` is a composite component that combines a `DatePicker` (segmented date input with calendar popover) and a `TimeField` (segmented time input) into a single control for selecting both date and time. The date segments and time segments render in a unified control area, separated by a visual separator. The calendar popover handles date selection; time segments are edited inline via the spinbutton pattern.
15

87	### 1.3 Context
88	
89	```rust
90	/// Context for the DateTimePicker component.
91	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
92	pub struct Context {
93	    /// The combined date-time value (controlled/uncontrolled).
94	    pub value: Bindable<Option<DateTime>>,
95	    /// The date portion of the value (synced from value or calendar selection).
96	    pub date_value: Option<CalendarDate>,
97	    /// The time portion of the value (synced from value or time segment edits).
98	    pub time_value: Option<Time>,
99	    /// The currently focused segment (date or time).
100	    pub focused_segment: Option<DateSegmentKind>,
101	    /// Whether the calendar popover is open.
102	    pub open: bool,
103	    /// Date segments (Year, Month, Day) in locale order.
104	    pub date_segments: Vec<DateSegment>,
105	    /// Time segments (Hour, Minute, optional Second, optional DayPeriod).
106	    pub time_segments: Vec<DateSegment>,
107	    /// The type-ahead buffer for numeric segment editing.
108	    pub type_buffer: String,
109	    /// The locale for formatting.
110	    pub locale: Locale,
111	    /// Resolved translatable messages.
112	    pub messages: Messages,
113	    /// The time granularity (Hour, Minute, Second).
114	    pub granularity: TimeGranularity,
115	    /// The resolved hour cycle.
116	    pub hour_cycle: HourCycle,
117	    /// Minimum allowed date-time.
118	    pub min_value: Option<DateTime>,
119	    /// Maximum allowed date-time.
120	    pub max_value: Option<DateTime>,
121	    /// Whether the component is disabled.
122	    pub disabled: bool,
123	    /// Whether the component is read-only.
124	    pub readonly: bool,
125	    /// Whether the field has been interacted with.
126	    pub is_touched: bool,
127	    /// Whether the field is required.
128	    pub required: bool,
129	    /// Form field name.

131	    /// Right-to-left layout.

133	    /// Component IDs.
134	    pub ids: ComponentIds,
135	}
136	
137	impl Context {
138	    /// All segments in display order: date segments, then time segments.
139	    pub fn all_segments(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &DateSegment> {
140	        self.date_segments.iter().chain(self.time_segments.iter())
141	    }
142	
143	    /// Find the first editable segment across date and time.
144	    pub fn first_editable(&self) -> Option<DateSegmentKind> {
145	        self.all_segments().find(|s| s.is_editable).map(|s| s.kind)
146	    }
147	
148	    /// Find the next editable segment after the given segment, crossing the
149	    /// date-to-time boundary when the current segment is the last date segment.
150	    pub fn next_editable_after(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind) -> Option<DateSegmentKind> {
151	        let all = self.all_segments().collect::<Vec<_>>();
152	        let idx = all.iter().position(|s| s.kind == kind)?;
153	        all[idx + 1..].iter().find(|s| s.is_editable).map(|s| s.kind)
154	    }
155	
156	    /// Find the previous editable segment before the given segment, crossing
157	    /// the time-to-date boundary when the current segment is the first time segment.
158	    pub fn prev_editable_before(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind) -> Option<DateSegmentKind> {
159	        let all = self.all_segments().collect::<Vec<_>>();
160	        let idx = all.iter().position(|s| s.kind == kind)?;
161	        all[..idx].iter().rev().find(|s| s.is_editable).map(|s| s.kind)
162	    }
163	
164	    /// Whether a segment belongs to the date group.
165	    pub fn is_date_segment(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind) -> bool {
166	        self.date_segments.iter().any(|s| s.kind == kind)
167	    }
168	
169	    /// Whether a segment belongs to the time group.
170	    pub fn is_time_segment(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind) -> bool {
171	        self.time_segments.iter().any(|s| s.kind == kind)
172	    }
173	
174	    /// Set a segment's value, looking in both date and time segment lists.
175	    pub fn set_segment_value(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind, raw: i32) {
176	        let seg = self.date_segments.iter_mut()
177	            .chain(self.time_segments.iter_mut())
178	            .find(|s| s.kind == kind);
179	        if let Some(seg) = seg {
180	            let v = raw.clamp(seg.min, seg.max);
181	            seg.value = Some(v);
182	            seg.text = format!("{:02}", v);
183	        }
184	    }
185	
186	    /// Clear a segment's value.
187	    pub fn clear_segment_value(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
188	        let seg = self.date_segments.iter_mut()
189	            .chain(self.time_segments.iter_mut())
190	            .find(|s| s.kind == kind);
191	        if let Some(seg) = seg {
192	            seg.value = None;
193	            seg.text = String::new();
194	        }
195	    }
196	
197	    /// Increment a segment's value, wrapping around.
198	    pub fn increment_segment(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
199	        let seg = self.date_segments.iter()
200	            .chain(self.time_segments.iter())
201	            .find(|s| s.kind == kind)
202	            .cloned();
203	        if let Some(seg) = seg {
204	            let cur  = seg.value.unwrap_or(seg.min);
205	            let next = if cur >= seg.max { seg.min } else { cur + 1 };
206	            self.set_segment_value(kind, next);
207	        }
208	    }
209	
210	    /// Decrement a segment's value, wrapping around.
211	    pub fn decrement_segment(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
212	        let seg = self.date_segments.iter()
213	            .chain(self.time_segments.iter())
214	            .find(|s| s.kind == kind)
215	            .cloned();
216	        if let Some(seg) = seg {
217	            let cur  = seg.value.unwrap_or(seg.max);
218	            let next = if cur <= seg.min { seg.max } else { cur - 1 };
219	            self.set_segment_value(kind, next);
220	        }
221	    }
222	
223	    /// Check if all editable segments across both date and time have values.
224	    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool {
225	        self.all_segments()
226	            .filter(|s| s.is_editable)
227	            .all(|s| s.value.is_some())
228	    }
229	
230	    /// Assemble a CalendarDate from current date segment values.
231	    pub fn assemble_date(&self) -> Option<CalendarDate> {
232	        let year  = self.date_segments.iter().find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Year)?.value?;
233	        let month = self.date_segments.iter().find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Month)?.value? as u8;
234	        let day   = self.date_segments.iter().find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Day)?.value? as u8;
235	        Some(CalendarDate::new_gregorian(
236	            year,
237	            NonZero::new(month).expect("month is 1-based from segment constraints"),
238	            NonZero::new(day).expect("day is 1-based from segment constraints"),
239	        ))
240	    }
241	
242	    /// Assemble a Time from current time segment values.
243	    pub fn assemble_time(&self) -> Option<Time> {
244	        let raw_hour = self.time_segments.iter().find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Hour)?.value? as u8;
245	        let minute   = self.time_segments.iter().find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Minute)?.value? as u8;
246	        let second   = self.time_segments.iter()
247	            .find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::Second)
248	            .and_then(|s| s.value)
249	            .unwrap_or(0) as u8;
250	
251	        let hour = if self.hour_cycle.has_day_period() {
252	            let is_pm = self.time_segments.iter()
253	                .find(|s| s.kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod)
254	                .and_then(|s| s.value)
255	                .unwrap_or(0) == 1;
256	            match self.hour_cycle {
257	                HourCycle::H12 => {
258	                    if is_pm { if raw_hour == 12 { 12 } else { raw_hour + 12 } }
259	                    else     { if raw_hour == 12 { 0  } else { raw_hour       } }
260	                }
261	                HourCycle::H11 => if is_pm { raw_hour + 12 } else { raw_hour },
262	                _ => raw_hour,
263	            }
264	        } else {
265	            raw_hour
266	        };
267	
268	        Some(Time::new(hour, minute, second))
269	    }
270	
271	    /// Assemble a DateTime from the current date and time segment values.
272	    pub fn assemble_datetime(&self) -> Option<DateTime> {
273	        let date = self.assemble_date()?;
274	        let time = self.assemble_time()?;
275	        Some(DateTime { date, time })
276	    }
277	}

356	
357	### 1.6 Composition Strategy
358	
359	The DateTimePicker does not embed separate `DatePicker` and `TimeField` machine instances. Instead, it manages a single unified state machine that owns both date segments and time segments. This design avoids cross-machine synchronization complexity and provides seamless segment navigation across the date-to-time boundary.
360	
361	**Segment layout**: Date segments (Year, Month, Day in locale order) appear first, followed by a visual Separator, then time segments (Hour, Minute, optional Second, optional DayPeriod). The segments are grouped into a `DateSegmentGroup` and a `TimeSegmentGroup` for ARIA labeling, but navigation treats them as a single linear sequence.
362	
363	**Value composition**: The combined `DateTime` value is assembled from individual segment values via `Context::assemble_datetime()`. When a date is selected from the calendar, only the date segments update; time segments retain their current values. When a time segment changes, only the time portion updates. The combined value is committed to `ctx.value` whenever all editable segments are complete.
364	
365	**Calendar popover**: The `Content` part renders an embedded `Calendar` component. The adapter creates a `Calendar` `Service` using `api.calendar_props()` and wires the Calendar's `SelectDate` event back to the DateTimePicker as `Event::CalendarSelectDate(date)`. When a date is selected, the popover closes and focus returns to the first time segment (so the user can confirm or adjust the time).
366	
367	**Segment navigation**: `FocusNextSegment` and `FocusPrevSegment` traverse all editable segments in linear order, crossing the date-to-time boundary transparently. Tab from the last date segment moves focus to the first time segment. Shift+Tab from the first time segment moves focus to the last date segment.
368	
369	### 1.7 Full Machine Implementation
370	
371	```rust
372	pub struct Machine;
373	
374	impl Machine {
375	    /// If all segments are complete, assemble and commit the DateTime value.
376	    fn maybe_publish(ctx: &mut Context) {
377	        if !ctx.is_complete() { return; }
378	        let Some(dt) = ctx.assemble_datetime() else { return };
379	        let clamped = match (&ctx.min_value, &ctx.max_value) {
380	            (Some(min), _) if dt < *min => min.clone(),
381	            (_, Some(max)) if dt > *max => max.clone(),
382	            _ => dt,
383	        };
384	        ctx.value.set(Some(clamped));
385	    }
386	
387	    /// Build date segments for the given locale and current date value.
388	    fn build_date_segments(locale: &Locale, date: &Option<CalendarDate>) -> Vec<DateSegment> {
389	        let mut segs = Vec::new();
390	
391	        let mut year_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Year, 1, 9999, "yyyy");
392	        let mut month_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Month, 1, 12, "mm");
393	        let mut day_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Day, 1, 31, "dd");
394	
395	        if let Some(d) = date {
396	            year_seg.value  = Some(d.year);
397	            year_seg.text   = format!("{:04}", d.year);
398	            month_seg.value = Some(d.month.get() as i32);
399	            month_seg.text  = format!("{:02}", d.month.get());
400	            day_seg.value   = Some(d.day.get() as i32);
401	            day_seg.text    = format!("{:02}", d.day.get());
402	        }
403	
404	        // Locale-dependent segment order.
405	        let locale_tag = locale.to_bcp47();
406	        match locale_tag.as_str() {
407	            "ja-JP" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | "ko-KR" => {
408	                segs.push(year_seg);
409	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
410	                segs.push(month_seg);
411	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
412	                segs.push(day_seg);
413	            }
414	            "en-GB" | "de-DE" | "fr-FR" | "es-ES" | "it-IT" | "ru-RU" => {
415	                segs.push(day_seg);
416	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
417	                segs.push(month_seg);
418	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
419	                segs.push(year_seg);
420	            }
421	            _ => {
422	                // en-US and fallback: MM/DD/YYYY
423	                segs.push(month_seg);
424	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
425	                segs.push(day_seg);
426	                segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("/"));
427	                segs.push(year_seg);
428	            }
429	        }
430	        segs
431	    }
432	
433	    /// Build time segments for the given hour cycle, granularity, and current time value.
434	    fn build_time_segments(
435	        hour_cycle: HourCycle,
436	        granularity: TimeGranularity,
437	        time: &Option<Time>,
438	    ) -> Vec<DateSegment> {
439	        let mut segs = Vec::new();
440	
441	        let (h_min, h_max) = hour_cycle.display_hour_range();
442	        let mut hour_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(
443	            DateSegmentKind::Hour, h_min as i32, h_max as i32, "hh",
444	        );
445	        if let Some(t) = time {
446	            let display = match hour_cycle {
447	                HourCycle::H12 => t.hour_12() as i32,
448	                HourCycle::H11 => (t.hour % 12) as i32,
449	                _              => t.hour as i32,
450	            };
451	            hour_seg.value = Some(display);
452	            hour_seg.text  = format!("{:02}", display);
453	        }
454	        segs.push(hour_seg);
455	
456	        segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal(":"));
457	
458	        let mut min_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Minute, 0, 59, "mm");
459	        if let Some(t) = time {
460	            min_seg.value = Some(t.minute as i32);
461	            min_seg.text  = format!("{:02}", t.minute);
462	        }
463	        segs.push(min_seg);
464	
465	        if granularity >= TimeGranularity::Second {
466	            segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal(":"));
467	            let mut sec_seg = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Second, 0, 59, "ss");
468	            if let Some(t) = time {
469	                sec_seg.value = Some(t.second as i32);
470	                sec_seg.text  = format!("{:02}", t.second);
471	            }
472	            segs.push(sec_seg);
473	        }
474	
475	        if hour_cycle.has_day_period() {
476	            segs.push(DateSegment::new_literal("\u{00A0}")); // non-breaking space
477	            let mut period_seg = DateSegment {
478	                kind: DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod,
479	                value: None,
480	                min: 0,
481	                max: 1,
482	                text: String::new(),
483	                placeholder: "AM".to_string(),
484	                literal: None,
485	                is_editable: true,
486	            };
487	            if let Some(t) = time {
488	                let is_pm = t.is_pm();
489	                period_seg.value = Some(if is_pm { 1 } else { 0 });
490	                period_seg.text  = if is_pm { "PM".to_string() } else { "AM".to_string() };
491	            }
492	            segs.push(period_seg);
493	        }
494	
495	        segs
496	    }
497	}
498	
499	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
500	    type State   = State;
501	    type Event   = Event;
502	    type Context = Context;
503	    type Props   = Props;
504	    type Messages = Messages;
505	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
506	
507	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
508	        let value = match props.value {
509	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v),
510	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
511	        };
512	
513	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
514	        let messages = messages.clone();
515	
516	        let date_value = value.get().as_ref().map(|dt| dt.date.clone());
517	        let time_value = value.get().as_ref().map(|dt| dt.time);
518	
519	        let resolved_cycle = props.hour_cycle.unwrap_or_else(|| locale.hour_cycle(&*env.intl_backend));
520	
521	        let date_segments = Machine::build_date_segments(&locale, &date_value);
522	        let time_segments = Machine::build_time_segments(
523	            resolved_cycle, props.granularity, &time_value,
524	        );
525	
526	        let ctx = Context {
527	            value,
528	            date_value,
529	            time_value,
530	            focused_segment: None,
531	            open: false,
532	            date_segments,
533	            time_segments,
534	            type_buffer: String::new(),
535	            locale,
536	            messages,
537	            granularity: props.granularity,
538	            hour_cycle: resolved_cycle,
539	            min_value: props.min_value.clone(),
540	            max_value: props.max_value.clone(),
541	            disabled: props.disabled,
542	            readonly: props.readonly,
543	            is_touched: false,
544	            required: props.required,
545	            name: props.name.clone(),
546	            is_rtl: props.is_rtl,
547	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
548	        };
549	
550	        (State::Idle, ctx)
551	    }
552	
553	    fn transition(
554	        state: &Self::State,
555	        event: &Self::Event,
556	        ctx: &Self::Context,
557	        props: &Self::Props,
558	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
559	        if is_disabled(ctx) { return None; }
560	
561	        match event {
562	            // ── Popover open / close ──────────────────────────────────────
563	            Event::Open => {
564	                if *state == State::Open || is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
565	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Open)
566	                    .apply(|ctx| {
567	                        ctx.open = true;
568	                    })
569	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus-calendar", |ctx, _props, _send| {
570	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
571	                        let grid_id = ctx.ids.part("calendar-grid");
572	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&grid_id);
573	                        no_cleanup()
574	                    })))
575	            }
576	
577	            Event::Close => {
578	                if *state != State::Open { return None; }
579	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
580	                    .apply(|ctx| {
581	                        ctx.open = false;
582	                    })
583	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("restore-focus", |ctx, _props, _send| {
584	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
585	                        let trigger_id = ctx.ids.part("trigger");
586	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&trigger_id);
587	                        no_cleanup()
588	                    })))
589	            }
590	
591	            Event::Toggle => {
592	                match state {
593	                    State::Open => Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props),
594	                    _           => Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props),
595	                }
596	            }
597	
598	            // ── Calendar date selection ───────────────────────────────────
599	            Event::CalendarSelectDate(date) => {
600	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
601	                let date = date.clone();
602	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
603	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
604	                        ctx.date_value = Some(date.clone());
605	                        ctx.open = false;
606	                        ctx.is_touched = true;
607	                        // Update date segments to reflect the selected date.
608	                        ctx.date_segments = Machine::build_date_segments(
609	                            &ctx.locale, &Some(date),
610	                        );
611	                        Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
612	                    })
613	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus-first-time-segment", |ctx, _props, _send| {
614	                        // After calendar selection, focus the first editable time segment
615	                        // so the user can confirm or adjust the time.
616	                        if let Some(seg) = ctx.time_segments.iter().find(|s| s.is_editable) {
617	                            let platform = use_platform_effects();
618	                            let seg_id = ctx.ids.item("segment", &seg.kind.as_str());
619	                            platform.focus_element_by_id(&seg_id);
620	                        }
621	                        no_cleanup()
622	                    })))
623	            }
624	
625	            Event::CalendarNext | Event::CalendarPrev => {
626	                // Delegated to the embedded Calendar machine via the adapter.
627	                // No state change in the DateTimePicker itself.
628	                None
629	            }
630	
631	            // ── Segment focus management ─────────────────────────────────
632	            Event::FocusSegment(kind) => {
633	                let k = *kind;
634	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
635	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
636	                        ctx.focused_segment = Some(k);
637	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
638	                    }))
639	            }
640	
641	            Event::FocusNextSegment => {
642	                match ctx.focused_segment {
643	                    Some(cur) => {
644	                        let has_buffer = !ctx.type_buffer.is_empty();
645	                        let next = ctx.next_editable_after(cur);
646	                        Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
647	                            .apply(move |ctx| {
648	                                if has_buffer {
649	                                    if let Ok(v) = ctx.type_buffer.parse::<i32>() {
650	                                        ctx.set_segment_value(cur, v);
651	                                        Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
652	                                    }
653	                                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
654	                                }
655	                                ctx.focused_segment = next;
656	                            }))
657	                    }
658	                    None => {
659	                        let first = ctx.first_editable()?;
660	                        Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
661	                            .apply(move |ctx| {
662	                                ctx.focused_segment = Some(first);
663	                            }))
664	                    }
665	                }
666	            }
667	
668	            Event::FocusPrevSegment => {
669	                let cur = ctx.focused_segment?;
670	                if !ctx.type_buffer.is_empty() {
671	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
672	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
673	                    }));
674	                }
675	                match ctx.prev_editable_before(cur) {
676	                    Some(k) => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
677	                        .apply(move |ctx| {
678	                            ctx.focused_segment = Some(k);
679	                        })),
680	                    None => None,
681	                }
682	            }
683	
684	            // ── Segment value editing ────────────────────────────────────
685	            Event::IncrementSegment { segment } => {
686	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
687	                let k = *segment;
688	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
689	                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
690	                    ctx.increment_segment(k);
691	                    ctx.is_touched = true;
692	                    Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
693	                }))
694	            }
695	
696	            Event::DecrementSegment { segment } => {
697	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
698	                let k = *segment;
699	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
700	                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
701	                    ctx.decrement_segment(k);
702	                    ctx.is_touched = true;
703	                    Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
704	                }))
705	            }
706	
707	            Event::TypeIntoSegment { segment, ch } => {
708	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
709	                let ch = *ch;
710	                let k = *segment;
711	                match k {
712	                    DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod => {
713	                        let lower = ch.to_ascii_lowercase();
714	                        if lower != 'a' && lower != 'p' { return None; }
715	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
716	                            match lower {
717	                                'a' => ctx.set_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod, 0),
718	                                'p' => ctx.set_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod, 1),
719	                                _ => {}
720	                            }
721	                            ctx.is_touched = true;
722	                            Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
723	                        }))
724	                    }
725	                    k2 if k2.is_numeric() => {
726	                        if !ch.is_ascii_digit() { return None; }
727	                        let mut new_buffer = ctx.type_buffer.clone();
728	                        new_buffer.push(ch);
729	                        let buffered: i32 = new_buffer.parse().unwrap_or(0);
730	                        let (seg_min, seg_max) = ctx.all_segments()
731	                            .find(|s| s.kind == k2)
732	                            .map(|s| (s.min, s.max))
733	                            .unwrap_or((0, 59));
734	                        let max_digits = digits_needed(seg_max);
735	                        let should_advance = new_buffer.len() >= max_digits
736	                            || buffered * 10 > seg_max;
737	                        let valid = buffered >= seg_min && buffered <= seg_max;
738	                        let next_seg = if should_advance { ctx.next_editable_after(k2) } else { None };
739	
740	                        let mut plan = TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
741	                            .apply(move |ctx| {
742	                                ctx.type_buffer.push(ch);
743	                                if valid {
744	                                    ctx.set_segment_value(k2, buffered);
745	                                    ctx.is_touched = true;
746	                                    Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
747	                                }
748	                                if should_advance {
749	                                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
750	                                    if let Some(nk) = next_seg {
751	                                        ctx.focused_segment = Some(nk);
752	                                    }
753	                                }
754	                            });
755	
756	                        if !should_advance {
757	                            plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::new(
758	                                "type-buffer-commit",
759	                                move |_ctx, _props, send| {
760	                                    let send = send.clone();
761	                                    Box::new(move || {
762	                                        send(Event::TypeBufferCommit { segment: k2 });
763	                                    })
764	                                },
765	                            ));
766	                        }
767	                        Some(plan)
768	                    }
769	                    _ => None,
770	                }
771	            }
772	
773	            Event::TypeBufferCommit { segment } => {
774	                let k = *segment;
775	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
776	                    if let Ok(v) = ctx.type_buffer.parse::<i32>() {
777	                        ctx.set_segment_value(k, v);
778	                        Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
779	                    }
780	                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
781	                }))
782	            }
783	
784	            Event::SegmentChange { segment, value } => {
785	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
786	                let k = *segment;
787	                let v = *value;
788	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
789	                    ctx.set_segment_value(k, v);
790	                    ctx.is_touched = true;
791	                    // Update the date/time sub-values.
792	                    if ctx.is_date_segment(k) {
793	                        ctx.date_value = ctx.assemble_date();
794	                    } else if ctx.is_time_segment(k) {
795	                        ctx.time_value = ctx.assemble_time();
796	                    }
797	                    Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
798	                }))
799	            }
800	
801	            Event::ValueCommit(dt) => {
802	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
803	                let dt = dt.clone();
804	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
805	                    ctx.value.set(dt.clone());
806	                    ctx.is_touched = true;
807	                    if let Some(ref dt) = dt {
808	                        ctx.date_value = Some(dt.date.clone());
809	                        ctx.time_value = Some(dt.time);
810	                        ctx.date_segments = Machine::build_date_segments(
811	                            &ctx.locale, &Some(dt.date.clone()),
812	                        );
813	                        ctx.time_segments = Machine::build_time_segments(
814	                            ctx.hour_cycle, ctx.granularity, &Some(dt.time),
815	                        );
816	                    }
817	                }))
818	            }
819	
820	            Event::ClearSegment { segment } => {
821	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
822	                let kind = *segment;
823	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
824	                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
825	                    ctx.clear_segment_value(kind);
826	                    ctx.value.set(None);
827	                }))
828	            }
829	
830	            Event::ClearAll => {
831	                if is_readonly(ctx) { return None; }
832	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
833	                    .apply(|ctx| {
834	                        let date_editable = ctx.date_segments.iter()
835	                            .filter(|s| s.is_editable).map(|s| s.kind).collect::<Vec<_>>();
836	                        for k in date_editable { ctx.clear_segment_value(k); }
837	                        let time_editable = ctx.time_segments.iter()
838	                            .filter(|s| s.is_editable).map(|s| s.kind).collect::<Vec<_>>();
839	                        for k in time_editable { ctx.clear_segment_value(k); }
840	                        ctx.date_value = None;
841	                        ctx.time_value = None;
842	                        ctx.value.set(None);
843	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
844	                    }))
845	            }
846	
847	            // ── Focus management ─────────────────────────────────────────
848	            Event::FocusIn => {
849	                if *state == State::Idle {
850	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
851	                        .apply(|_ctx| {}))
852	                } else {
853	                    None
854	                }
855	            }
856	
857	            Event::FocusOut => {
858	                // Commit any pending type buffer, close popover if open.
859	                let has_buffer = !ctx.type_buffer.is_empty();
860	                let focused = ctx.focused_segment;
861	                let was_open = ctx.open;
862	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
863	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
864	                        if has_buffer {
865	                            if let (Some(k), Ok(v)) = (focused, ctx.type_buffer.parse::<i32>()) {
866	                                ctx.set_segment_value(k, v);
867	                                Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);
868	                            }
869	                        }
870	                        ctx.focused_segment = None;
871	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
872	                        if was_open {
873	                            ctx.open = false;
874	                        }
875	                    }))
876	            }
877	
878	            // ── Keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────
879	            Event::KeyDown { key } => {
880	                match key {
881	                    KeyboardKey::Escape if *state == State::Open => {
882	                        Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props)
883	                    }
884	                    KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if *state != State::Open => {
885	                        // Alt+ArrowDown opens the picker (modifier check at adapter level).
886	                        Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props)
887	                    }
888	                    _ => None,
889	                }
890	            }
891	        }
892	    }
893	
894	    fn connect<'a>(
895	        state: &'a Self::State,
896	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
897	        props: &'a Self::Props,
898	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
899	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
900	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
901	    }
902	}

1354	    │   │   ├── Literal "/"             aria-hidden="true"

1359	    │   │   ├── Literal ":"             aria-hidden="true"

1391	## 3. Accessibility
1392	
1393	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
1394	
1395	| Element            | Role/Attribute          | Details                                                                                |
1396	| ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
1397	| `Control`          | `role="group"`          | Groups all segments; `aria-labelledby` points to Label                                 |
1398	| `DateSegmentGroup` | `role="group"`          | `aria-label="Date"`; groups date segments                                              |
1399	| `TimeSegmentGroup` | `role="group"`          | `aria-label="Time"`; groups time segments                                              |
1400	| `Segment`          | `role="spinbutton"`     | `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuetext`, `aria-label`      |
1401	| `Trigger`          | `<button>`              | `aria-label="Open date and time picker"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`             |
1402	| `ClearTrigger`     | `<button>`              | `aria-label="Clear date and time"`                                                     |
1403	| `Content`          | `role="dialog"`         | Contains the Calendar; announced when opened                                           |
1404	| `ErrorMessage`     | `role="alert"`          | `aria-live="polite"`; announced immediately on render                                  |
1405	| `Literal`          | `<span>`                | `aria-hidden="true"`; decorative separators                                            |
1406	| `Separator`        | `<span>`                | `aria-hidden="true"`; decorative separator between date and time                       |
1407	| `HiddenInput`      | `<input type="hidden">` | Carries the ISO 8601 value; `aria-describedby` chains Description and ErrorMessage IDs |
1408	
1409	When `disabled=true`: all segments receive `aria-disabled="true"`, trigger and clear buttons are disabled.
1410	When `readonly=true`: all segments receive `aria-readonly="true"`, trigger and clear buttons are disabled.
1411	When `required=true`: the DateSegmentGroup receives `aria-required="true"`.
1412	When `invalid=true`: the DateSegmentGroup receives `aria-invalid="true"`, and the ErrorMessage part is rendered.
1413	
1414	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
1415	
1416	| Key                    | Context                            | Action                                                     |
1417	| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
1418	| `ArrowUp`              | Segment focused                    | Increment the focused segment value by 1, wrapping         |
1419	| `ArrowDown`            | Segment focused                    | Decrement the focused segment value by 1, wrapping         |
1420	| `ArrowLeft`            | Segment focused                    | Move focus to the previous editable segment (date or time) |
1421	| `ArrowRight`           | Segment focused                    | Move focus to the next editable segment (date or time)     |
1422	| `Tab`                  | Last date segment focused          | Move focus to the first time segment                       |
1423	| `Shift+Tab`            | First time segment focused         | Move focus to the last date segment                        |
1424	| `Tab`                  | Last time segment focused          | Move focus to the trigger button                           |
1425	| `0`-`9`                | Numeric segment focused            | Type-ahead entry; auto-advances to next segment when full  |
1426	| `a` / `p`              | DayPeriod segment focused          | Set AM / PM                                                |
1427	| `Backspace` / `Delete` | Segment focused                    | Clear the focused segment value                            |
1428	| `Enter` / `Space`      | Trigger focused                    | Toggle the popover open/closed                             |
1429	| `ArrowDown`            | Trigger focused or segment focused | Open the calendar popover (Alt+ArrowDown at adapter level) |
1430	| `Escape`               | Popover open                       | Close the popover; return focus to the trigger             |
1431	
1432	> RTL: `ArrowLeft` and `ArrowRight` swap direction for segment navigation per `03-accessibility.md` section 4.1.
1433	
1434	### 3.3 Focus Management
1435	
1436	1. User tabs to the first date segment or the trigger button.
1437	2. Arrow keys navigate between segments within the date and time groups. Navigation crosses the date-to-time boundary seamlessly.
1438	3. Clicking the trigger or pressing Enter/Space on it opens the calendar popover.
1439	4. When the popover opens, focus moves into the Calendar grid (first selected date, or today).
1440	5. Selecting a date in the calendar closes the popover and moves focus to the first time segment, so the user can confirm or adjust the time.
1441	6. Pressing Escape in the popover closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
1442	7. Tab from inside the calendar closes the popover and moves focus to the next focusable element after the DateTimePicker.
1443	8. When focus leaves the component entirely (`FocusOut`), any pending type-ahead buffer is committed and the popover closes.
1444	
1445	## 4. Internationalization
1446	
1447	### 4.1 Messages
1448	
1449	```rust
1450	/// Messages for the DateTimePicker component.
1451	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
1452	pub struct Messages {
1453	    /// Trigger button label (default: "Open date and time picker").
1454	    pub trigger_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1455	    /// Clear button label (default: "Clear date and time").
1456	    pub clear_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1457	    /// Date segment group label (default: "Date").
1458	    pub date_group_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1459	    /// Time segment group label (default: "Time").
1460	    pub time_group_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1461	    /// Announces the selected date-time (e.g., "Selected: March 15, 2025 2:30 PM").
1462	    pub selected_datetime_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&str, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1463	}
1464	
1465	impl Default for Messages {
1466	    fn default() -> Self {
1467	        Self {
1468	            trigger_label: MessageFn::static_str("Open date and time picker"),
1469	            clear_label: MessageFn::static_str("Clear date and time"),
1470	            date_group_label: MessageFn::static_str("Date"),
1471	            time_group_label: MessageFn::static_str("Time"),
1472	            selected_datetime_label: MessageFn::new(|value, _locale| {
1473	                format!("Selected: {}", value)
1474	            }),
1475	        }
1476	    }
1477	}
1478	
1479	impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}
1480	```
1481	
1482	All user-visible text is provided via the `Messages` struct. Individual segment labels (e.g., "Year", "Hour", "AM/PM") are inherited from the `DateSegmentKind::aria_label()` method defined in date-field's segment types. Date segment order and separators are locale-dependent (see `Machine::build_date_segments()`). Time segment display uses the locale's preferred hour cycle when `hour_cycle` is `None`.
1483	
1484	## 5. Form Integration
1485	
1486	The DateTimePicker participates in HTML form submission via a hidden `<input type="hidden">` element rendered by the `HiddenInput` part. The hidden input carries the combined date-time value in ISO 8601 format.
1487	
1488	- **ISO value**: The hidden input's `value` is always `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (e.g., `2024-03-15T14:30:00`), regardless of the display format or locale used in the visible segments.
1489	- **`name` prop**: When set, the hidden input includes `name="{value}"` so the date-time is submitted with the form under that key.
1490	- **Required validation**: When `required=true`, the DateSegmentGroup carries `aria-required="true"`. Form validation treats an empty value (no date-time selected) as invalid.
1491	- **Reset**: On form reset, the adapter restores the initial value (the `default_value` from Props or `None`) and rebuilds all segments accordingly.
1492	- **`aria-describedby`**: The Control group's `aria-describedby` chains the Description and ErrorMessage part IDs so assistive technology announces help text and validation errors in context.
1493	- **Disabled/readonly propagation**: When the DateTimePicker is nested inside a form context that sets `disabled` or `readonly`, those values propagate per `07-forms.md` section 15.
1494	
1495	## 6. Library Parity
1496	
1497	> Compared against: Ark UI (`DatePicker`).
1498	
1499	Ark UI does not have a dedicated DateTimePicker component. Its `DatePicker` supports time selection only indirectly (time segments are not part of its anatomy). ars-ui's DateTimePicker is a novel composite that unifies date segments, time segments, and a calendar popover into a single state machine, providing a more integrated experience than Ark UI's date-only picker.

1506	| Min/max          | `min_value`, `max_value` (DateTime) | `min`, `max` (DateValue) | ars-ui includes time constraints           |
1507	| Granularity      | `granularity` (TimeGranularity)     | --                       | ars-ui adds time granularity               |

1509	| Calendar system  | `calendar`                          | --                       | ars-ui supports non-Gregorian              |

**ConnectApi implementation** (Lines 1737–1755):
```rust
impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
    type Part = Part;

    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
        match part {
            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
            Part::Control => self.control_attrs(),
            Part::Input => self.input_attrs(),
            Part::Trigger => self.trigger_attrs(),
            Part::ClearTrigger => self.clear_trigger_attrs(),
            Part::Positioner => self.positioner_attrs(),
            Part::Content => self.content_attrs(),
            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),
            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),
            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
        }
    }
}
```

/// Builds [`Calendar`](super::calendar) props from the current state.
///

#[must_use]
pub fn calendar_props(&self) -> calendar::Props {

        // Forward the adapter-injected "today" so the calendar opens on the
        // current month and marks the correct day (otherwise it would fall
        // back to `calendar::Props::default().today`, a fixed test date).
        today: self.ctx.today.clone(),
        ..calendar::Props::default()
    }
}

**Effect enum** (Lines 123–158):

**Effect emission** (e.g., Line 785):
```rust
plan = plan
    .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
        ctx.requested_open = target_open;
        if controlled {

            ctx.requested_focus = Some(focus);
        }
    })

The `TransitionPlan` builder supports chaining:
- `.apply(|ctx| { ... })` — a closure mutating context
- `.with_effect(effect)` — attaching a `PendingEffect`
- `.to(next_state)` — transitioning to a new state

**Date picker does NOT use `use_platform_effects()` or `no_cleanup()`.** Those are spec pseudo-code concepts; the real implementation uses typed `Effect` enum variants and the adapter reads `PendingEffect::name` to dispatch actual focus operations.

## Summary

**DatePicker is a sophisticated, fully-featured composite component that:**

1. **Uses typed effects (`Effect` enum)** rather than platform callbacks, allowing adapters to dispatch focus operations after seeing the named effect
2. **Implements controlled prop sync** via `Event::SyncProps` and `on_props_changed`, keeping value/open/min/max/disabled in sync
3. **Delegates calendar rendering** to a sibling `Calendar` machine, forwarding constraints and selection changes
4. **Manages complex focus semantics** with `OpenFocus` enum and deferred focus intents for controlled-open reconciliation
5. **Formats/parses dates** according to locale-derived order (via `date_order()`) with separator and field translation
6. **Uses `ComponentIds` for part IDs** derived from the base ID via `.part(name)` method calls
7. **Structures test helpers** to build `Service<Machine>` instances and capture effects/attributes for golden-file snapshots

For a **DateTimePicker sibling**, you'd mirror this structure: a `Machine` with `State`, `Event`, `Context`, `Props`, `Messages`, `Effect`, and `Api` types, managing both date and time input fields, reusing the Calendar component for date selection, and extending the locale/format infrastructure to handle time parsing and formatting.

pub struct Bindable<T: BindableValue> {
    /// The externally controlled value, or `None` if uncontrolled.
    controlled: Option<T>,

    /// The internal value managed by the component.
    internal: T,
}

impl<T: BindableValue> Bindable<T> {
    /// Creates a controlled bindable owned by the parent.
    pub fn controlled(value: T) -> Self { ... }

    /// Creates an uncontrolled bindable managed by the component.
    pub const fn uncontrolled(default: T) -> Self { ... }

    /// Returns a reference to the current value.
    pub fn get(&self) -> &T { ... }

    /// Returns `true` if this value is controlled by the parent.
    pub const fn is_controlled(&self) -> bool { ... }

    /// Updates the internal value.
    pub fn set(&mut self, value: T) { ... }

    /// Pushes a new controlled value from the parent.
    pub fn sync_controlled(&mut self, value: Option<T>) { ... }

    /// Returns a mutable reference to the internal value.
    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T { ... }

    /// Returns the internal (pending) value, ignoring any controlled override.
    pub const fn pending(&self) -> &T { ... }
}

fn maybe_publish(ctx: &mut Context) {
    if !ctx.is_complete() {
        return;
    }

    let Some(time) = ctx.assemble_time() else {
        return;
    };

    let clamped = clamp_time(time, ctx.min_value.as_ref(), ctx.max_value.as_ref());

    apply_segments_from_time(ctx, clamped);

    ctx.value.set(Some(clamped));
}
```
- Only publishes if `is_complete()` (all editable segments have values)
- Calls `assemble_time()` to build validated Time from segments
- Clamps to min/max bounds
- Calls `ctx.value.set(Some(clamped))` to update the Bindable value

**Segment building** (lines 1753-1826):
```rust
fn build_segments(ctx: &Context) -> Vec<DateSegment>
```
- Creates hour segment: `DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Hour, hour_min, hour_max, "hh")`
- Adds literal `:` between hour/minute/second
- For day period (H11/H12), adds non-editable day-period segment with min=0, max=1
- All segments initialized with values from current `ctx.value` if present

    #[must_use]
    pub fn aria_label(&self, messages: &Messages, locale: &Locale) -> String {
        fn call(
            message: &MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
            locale: &Locale,
        ) -> String {
            message(locale)
        }

        match self {
            Self::Year => call(&messages.year_label, locale),
            Self::Month => call(&messages.month_label, locale),
            Self::Day => call(&messages.day_label, locale),
            Self::Hour => call(&messages.hour_label, locale),
            Self::Minute => call(&messages.minute_label, locale),
            Self::Second => call(&messages.second_label, locale),
            Self::DayPeriod => call(&messages.day_period_label, locale),
            Self::Weekday => call(&messages.weekday_label, locale),
            Self::Era => call(&messages.era_label, locale),
            Self::Literal => String::new(),
            Self::TimeZoneName => call(&messages.timezone_label, locale),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) const fn data_name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Year => "year",
            Self::Month => "month",
            Self::Day => "day",
            Self::Hour => "hour",
            Self::Minute => "minute",
            Self::Second => "second",
            Self::DayPeriod => "day-period",
            Self::Weekday => "weekday",
            Self::Era => "era",
            Self::Literal => "literal",
            Self::TimeZoneName => "time-zone-name",
        }
    }
}

416	/// Returns the locale-appropriate default date format pattern.
417	///
418	/// Field order comes from [`ars_i18n::date_order`], which uses real locale data
419	/// — CLDR via ICU4X or the browser `Intl` API where a backend is compiled in,
420	/// and a `(language, region)` heuristic otherwise — so every locale gets the
421	/// correct month/day/year order (the sibling [`date_field`](super::date_field)
422	/// uses the same source). The field separator stays a small locale heuristic
423	/// (`.` for German and Korean, `/` elsewhere), mirroring `date_field`'s literal.
424	fn default_format_for_locale(locale: &Locale) -> String {
425	    let separator = match (locale.language(), locale.region()) {
426	        ("de", Some("DE")) | ("ko", Some("KR")) => '.',
427	        _ => '/',
428	    };
429	
430	    let order: [&str; 3] = match date_order(locale) {
431	        DateOrder::MonthDayYear => ["MM", "dd", "yyyy"],
432	        DateOrder::DayMonthYear => ["dd", "MM", "yyyy"],
433	        DateOrder::YearMonthDay => ["yyyy", "MM", "dd"],
434	    };
435	
436	    format!("{}{separator}{}{separator}{}", order[0], order[1], order[2])
437	}
438	
439	/// Parses a format pattern into its field separator and ordered fields.
440	///
441	/// The separator is the first non-alphabetic character (defaulting to `'/'`);
442	/// each token's leading letter selects the field (`y`→year, `M`→month,
443	/// `d`→day). Patterns that do not split into three tokens fall back to
444	/// month/day/year.
445	fn parse_format(format: &str) -> (char, [DateField; 3]) {
446	    let sep = format
447	        .chars()
448	        .find(|c| !c.is_ascii_alphabetic())
449	        .unwrap_or('/');
450	
451	    let mut order = [DateField::Month, DateField::Day, DateField::Year];
452	
453	    let tokens = format.split(sep).collect::<Vec<_>>();
454	
455	    if tokens.len() == 3 {
456	        for (index, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
457	            order[index] = match token.chars().next() {
458	                Some('y' | 'Y') => DateField::Year,
459	                Some('d' | 'D') => DateField::Day,
460	                _ => DateField::Month,
461	            };
462	        }
463	    }
464	
465	    (sep, order)
466	}
467	
468	/// Formats a [`CalendarDate`] according to the given pattern.
469	///
470	/// Month and day are zero-padded to two digits, year to four, in the field
471	/// order described by `format`.
472	fn format_date(date: &CalendarDate, format: &str) -> String {
473	    let (sep, order) = parse_format(format);
474	
475	    let mut out = String::new();
476	
477	    for (index, field) in order.iter().enumerate() {
478	        if index > 0 {
479	            out.push(sep);
480	        }
481	
482	        match field {
483	            DateField::Year => {
484	                let _ = write!(out, "{:04}", date.year());
485	            }
486	
487	            DateField::Month => {
488	                let _ = write!(out, "{:02}", date.month());
489	            }
490	
491	            DateField::Day => {
492	                let _ = write!(out, "{:02}", date.day());
493	            }
494	        }
495	    }
496	
497	    out
498	}

===== DateField build_segments + how segment id built in segment_attrs =====
fn build_segments(ctx: &Context) -> Vec<DateSegment> {
    let mut segments = Vec::new();

    let pattern = segment_pattern(ctx);

    let value = ctx.value.get().clone();

    for part in pattern {
        let kind = match part {
            SegmentPatternPart::Segment(kind) => kind,

            SegmentPatternPart::Literal(literal) => {
                segments.push(DateSegment::new_literal(literal));

                continue;
            }
        };

        let (min, max, placeholder) = match kind {
            DateSegmentKind::Year => (1, 9999, "yyyy"),

            DateSegmentKind::Month => (1, 12, "mm"),

            DateSegmentKind::Day => (1, 31, "dd"),

            DateSegmentKind::Era => (
                1,
                i32::try_from(ctx.calendar.eras().len()).unwrap_or(1).max(1),
                "era",
            ),

            _ => (0, 0, ""),
        };

        if !kind.is_editable() {
            segments.push(DateSegment::new_non_editable(
                kind,
                &non_editable_segment_text(ctx, kind, value.as_ref()),
            ));

            continue;
        }

        let mut segment = DateSegment::new_numeric(kind, min, max, placeholder);

        if let Some(date) = &value {
            let segment_value = match kind {
                DateSegmentKind::Year => Some(date.year()),

                DateSegmentKind::Month => Some(i32::from(date.month())),

                DateSegmentKind::Day => Some(i32::from(date.day())),

                DateSegmentKind::Era => ctx.era_index_for_date(date),

                _ => None,
            };

            if let Some(segment_value) = segment_value {
                segment.value = Some(segment_value);
                segment.text = ctx.format_segment_value(kind, segment_value);
            }
        }

        segments.push(segment);
    }

    segments
}

## Approved Plan (edited by user):
# Task #292 — Implement DateTimePicker agnostic core

## Context

GitHub issue #292 (Epic #224) asks for the framework-agnostic core of `DateTimePicker`: a
composite that unifies a **segmented date input** (like `DateField`), a **segmented time input**
(like `TimeField`), and a **calendar popover + trigger** (like `DatePicker`) into a single state
machine that owns both date and time segments and produces a combined `CalendarDateTime` value.
Dependencies #272 (TimeField) and #289 (DatePicker) are both merged. Scope is the agnostic
machine only — no Leptos/Dioxus adapters. Test tier: Unit (+ snapshots + spec-conformance).

**Important finding — the spec is heavily drifted.** `spec/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md`
§1.3/§1.7/§1.8/§4.1 was written against idealized pseudo-code that does **not** compile against
the real workspace API, while the sibling specs (`date-picker.md`, `time-field.md`) were already
migrated to the real conventions. Per CLAUDE.md ("resolve spec/code mismatch in the same task"),
this PR must rewrite those sections to match reality. Concrete drift to fix:

- Uses a nonexistent `DateTime` type. Real type is `ars_i18n::CalendarDateTime` with **private**
  `date`/`time` fields, ctor `CalendarDateTime::new(date, time)`, accessors `.date()`/`.time()`.
- `maybe_publish` compares values with `<`/`>`, but `CalendarDate` does **not** derive `Ord`.
  Must compare via `CalendarDate::compare(&self, other) -> Ordering` then `Time::cmp` (Time is Ord).
- Effects use idealized `PendingEffect::new(name, closure)` + `use_platform_effects()` + `no_cleanup()`.
  Real convention (date_picker/time_field): a typed `Effect` enum + `PendingEffect::named(Effect::X)`,
  and `type Effect = Effect;` on the Machine impl. Adapters dispatch on `effect.name`.
- `Context` `root_attrs` reads `ctx.parsed_date` / `ctx.parsed_time` / `ctx.format` — none exist.
- `assemble_date` uses `NonZero` month/day; real `CalendarDate::new_gregorian(year: i32, month: u8,
  day: u8) -> Result<_, _>` (plain `u8`, returns `Result`).
- `assemble_time` calls `Time::new(h,m,s)`; real is `Time::new(h,m,s, millis: u16) -> Result<_, _>`.
- `kind.as_str()` / `kind.aria_label()` (no-arg) — real: `DateSegmentKind::data_name(self)` (`pub(crate)`)
  and `aria_label(&self, &Messages, &Locale)`.
- `HourCycle::has_day_period()` / `display_hour_range()` — not methods; they are free fns in time_field.
- `KeyboardKey::Char(ch)` does not exist; segment typing flows via `KeyboardEventData.character`
  (TimeField pattern: `Api::on_segment_keydown(kind, &KeyboardEventData)`).

## Key types & reuse (verified)

- Segments: `date_time::date_field::segment::{DateSegment, DateSegmentKind}` (re-exported at
  `date_field::{DateSegment, DateSegmentKind}`). Ctors `DateSegment::new_numeric(kind, min, max, &str)`,
  `new_literal(&str)`, `new_non_editable(kind, &str)`. `DateSegmentKind::{is_editable, is_numeric, data_name}`.
- Date order: `ars_i18n::{date_order, DateOrder}` (CLDR-backed) — reuse for locale segment order +
  the `.`/`/` separator heuristic from `date_picker::default_format_for_locale`.
- `CalendarDate`: `new_gregorian`, `.year()/.month()/.day()`, `.compare(&self,&Self)->Ordering`.
- `Time`: `new(h,m,s,ms)->Result`, `.hour()/.minute()/.second()`, derives `Ord`.
- `CalendarDateTime::{new, date, time}`. `HourCycle::{H11,H12,H23,H24}`. `TimeGranularity` (Ord).
- `Bindable::{controlled, uncontrolled, get, set, sync_controlled}`; `ComponentIds::{from_id, id,
  part, item}` (`item(part, &key)`); `Env::new(locale, Arc<dyn IntlBackend>)`, `env.locale`,
  `env.intl_backend`; `locale.hour_cycle(&*env.intl_backend)`.
- `Service::<Machine>::new(props, &env, &messages)`, `svc.connect(&send)`, `svc.take_initial_effects()`.
- `#[derive(ars_core::ComponentPart)] #[scope="..."]`; `Part::X.data_attrs()` → 2 `(HtmlAttr,_)` pairs.
- Snapshot helper (per-file, copy it): `fn snapshot_attrs(a:&AttrMap)->String { format!("{a:#?}") }`,
  asserted with `insta::assert_snapshot!("name", snapshot_attrs(&api.x_attrs()))`. Test env uses
  `StubIntlBackend` + `en_us()` locale (mirror `date_picker/tests.rs`).

## Approach

### 1. Shared hour-cycle helpers (per user decision: promote to shared module)
- New `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/hour_cycle.rs` (`pub(crate) mod hour_cycle;` in
  `date_time/mod.rs`). Move from `time_field/mod.rs`: `display_hour_range`, `has_day_period`,
  `display_hour`, `display_hour_to_24`, `is_pm`, and `digits_needed`. Make them `pub(crate)`.
- Refactor `time_field/mod.rs` to `use super::hour_cycle::*` and delete the local copies. Run
  TimeField's existing tests to confirm no behavior change.

### 2. New machine — `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs`
Mirror DatePicker/TimeField structure. Public items (all documented for `missing_docs`):
- `State` { Idle, Focused, Open }, `Event` (per spec §1.2; replace `KeyDown{key}` handling so
  segment typing comes through the Api via `KeyboardEventData`), `Context`, `Props` (add
  `today: CalendarDate` injected by adapter — forwarded to `calendar_props`, default like Calendar's
  `2025-01-01`), `Messages` (spec's 5 fields **plus** per-segment label fields:
  `year_label/month_label/day_label/hour_label/minute_label/second_label/day_period_label` —
  user decision), and a typed `Effect` enum
  { OpenChange, ValueChange, FocusCalendar, RestoreFocusToTrigger, FocusFirstTimeSegment, TypeBufferCommit }.
- Context fields: `value: Bindable<Option<CalendarDateTime>>`, `date_value: Option<CalendarDate>`,
  `time_value: Option<Time>`, `focused_segment`, `open`, `date_segments`, `time_segments`,
  `type_buffer`, `locale`, `messages`, `intl_backend: Arc<dyn IntlBackend>`, `granularity`,
  `hour_cycle`, `min_value/max_value: Option<CalendarDateTime>`, `disabled/readonly/required/invalid`,
  `is_touched`, `name`, `is_rtl`, `today`, `ids`. Keep the spec's Context helper methods
  (`all_segments`, `first_editable`, `next_editable_after`, `prev_editable_before`, `is_date_segment`,
  `is_time_segment`, `set_segment_value`, `clear_segment_value`, `increment/decrement_segment`,
  `is_complete`, `assemble_date`, `assemble_time`, `assemble_datetime`) but corrected to real APIs
  (Gregorian assembly via `new_gregorian(...).ok()`; time via `hour_cycle::display_hour_to_24` +
  `Time::new(...,0).ok()`).
- `Machine`: `init` (build date segments via `date_order`, time segments via `hour_cycle` helpers,
  resolve cycle via `props.hour_cycle.unwrap_or(locale.hour_cycle(&*env.intl_backend))`), `transition`
  (port spec arms; emit `PendingEffect::named`), `on_props_changed`/`SyncProps` for controlled
  `value`/`min`/`max`/`disabled` sync (mirror DatePicker), `connect`.
- `cmp_datetime(a,b)` helper: `a.date().compare(b.date())` then `a.time().cmp(b.time())`;
  `maybe_publish` clamps with it.
- `Part` enum + `Api` with all `*_attrs()` getters and event handlers per spec §1.8, corrected:
  `segment_attrs` id via `ids.item("segment", &kind.data_name())`, label via local resolver over the
  new `Messages` segment fields (TimeField's `time_segment_aria_label` pattern); `root_attrs` announce
  label built from a local `format_datetime(date,time,locale)` (reuse date_order pattern + h:m[:s]),
  not the bogus `parsed_*`/`format`; `hidden_input_attrs` ISO via
  `format!("{:04}-{:02}-{:02}T{:02}:{:02}:{:02}", date.year(), date.month(), date.day(), time.hour(),
  time.minute(), time.second())`; `calendar_props()` builds `calendar::Props { id:
  format!("{}-calendar", ids.id()), value: Some(date_value.clone()), min/max from min_value/max_value
  `.map(|dt| dt.date().clone())`, disabled, readonly, is_rtl, visible_months, today, ..Default }`.
  `on_segment_keydown(kind, &KeyboardEventData)`; `on_trigger_keydown(&KeyboardEventData)`;
  `on_content_keydown(&KeyboardEventData)`. `ConnectApi for Api` maps every `Part`.

### 3. Wire module
- `date_time/mod.rs`: add `pub mod date_time_picker;` and `pub(crate) mod hour_cycle;`.

### 4. Tests (TDD — write first) — `date_time_picker/tests.rs`
Named tests from the issue, plus conformance & snapshots:
- Date segments **and** time segments both present; trigger + calendar `Content` parts exist.
- Combined value renders ISO `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` in `hidden_input_attrs`.
- `CalendarSelectDate` preserves existing time segments/value; date-only updates date.
- Editing a time segment (type-ahead / increment) preserves existing date value.
- Form integration: `name` + ISO value on hidden input.
- Min/max `CalendarDateTime` clamping via `maybe_publish` across date+time.
- ConnectApi: `Control` `role=group`+`aria-labelledby`; `DateSegmentGroup`/`TimeSegmentGroup`
  `role=group` + `aria-label`; `aria-required`/`aria-invalid` on date group when set.
- Spec-conformance: `Part` enum variants/anatomy + spinbutton attrs (`role`, `aria-valuemin/max/now/text`).
- Snapshot tests for every anatomy part and each output-affecting state/prop/context branch
  (idle/focused/open, disabled, readonly, invalid, rtl, with/without value, clear-trigger
  hidden-when-empty, h12 vs h23, granularity second), committed `.snap` under `snapshots/`,
  passing `cargo insta test --unreferenced=reject`.

### 5. Spec sync (same PR)
Rewrite `spec/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md`:
- §1.3 Context: `CalendarDateTime`, add `intl_backend`, `today`, `invalid`, corrected helper bodies.
- §1.4 Props: add `today`; keep `calendar`/`hour_cycle`/`visible_months`.
- §1.7: typed `Effect` enum, `PendingEffect::named`, `on_props_changed`/`SyncProps`, `date_order`

516	            u8::try_from(self.get_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Minute)?).ok()?

518	            0

550	    /// Sets and formats a segment value within that segment's valid range.
551	    pub fn set_segment_value(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind, raw: i32) {
552	        let Some(index) = self

564	        let min = self.segments[index].min;
565	        let max = self.segments[index].max;
566	        let value = raw.clamp(min, max);
567	        let text = self.format_segment_value(kind, value);
568	
569	        self.segments[index].value = Some(value);
570	        self.segments[index].text = text;
571	    }
572	
573	    /// Clears a segment value.
574	    pub fn clear_segment_value(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
575	        if let Some(segment) = self.segment_mut(kind) {
576	            segment.value = None;
577	            segment.text.clear();
578	        }
579	    }
580	
581	    /// Increment the value of a segment, wrapping within its range.
582	    pub fn increment_segment(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
583	        self.step_segment_value(kind, 1);
584	    }
585	
586	    /// Decrement the value of a segment, wrapping within its range.
587	    pub fn decrement_segment(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind) {
588	        self.step_segment_value(kind, -1);
589	    }
590	
591	    fn step_segment_value(&mut self, kind: DateSegmentKind, delta: i32) {
592	        let Some(segment) = self
593	            .segments
594	            .iter()
595	            .find(|segment| segment.kind == kind && segment.is_editable)
596	            .cloned()
597	        else {
598	            return;
599	        };
600	
601	        if kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod && segment.value.is_none() {
602	            self.set_segment_value(kind, if delta >= 0 { segment.max } else { segment.min });
603	
604	            return;
605	        }
606	
607	        let current = segment.value.unwrap_or(if delta >= 0 {
608	            segment.min - 1
609	        } else {
610	            segment.max + 1
611	        });
612	
613	        let span = segment.max - segment.min + 1;
614	        let next = (current - segment.min + delta).rem_euclid(span) + segment.min;
615	
616	        self.set_segment_value(kind, next);
617	    }
618	
619	    fn format_segment_value(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind, value: i32) -> String {
620	        format_time_segment(
621	            self.intl_backend.as_ref(),
622	            &self.locale,
623	            kind,
624	            value,
625	            self.force_leading_zeros,
626	        )
627	    }
628	}

666	/// Machine for the `TimeField` component.

668	pub struct Machine;
669	
670	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
671	    type State = State;
672	    type Event = Event;
673	    type Context = Context;
674	    type Props = Props;
675	    type Messages = Messages;
676	    type Effect = Effect;
677	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
678	
679	    fn init(
680	        props: &Self::Props,
681	        env: &Env,
682	        messages: &Self::Messages,
683	    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
684	        let value = if let Some(value) = props.value {
685	            Bindable::controlled(value)
686	        } else {
687	            Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value)
688	        };
689	
690	        let mut ctx = Context {
691	            value,
692	            segments: Vec::new(),
693	            focused_segment: None,
694	            type_buffer: String::new(),
695	            is_composing: false,
696	            locale: env.locale.clone(),
697	            messages: messages.clone(),
698	            intl_backend: Arc::clone(&env.intl_backend),
699	            granularity: props.granularity,
700	            hour_cycle: props
701	                .hour_cycle
702	                .unwrap_or_else(|| env.locale.hour_cycle(env.intl_backend.as_ref())),
703	            disabled: props.disabled,
704	            readonly: props.readonly,
705	            min_value: props.min_value,
706	            max_value: props.max_value,
707	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
708	            force_leading_zeros: props.force_leading_zeros,
709	        };
710	
711	        ctx.rebuild_segments();
712	
713	        (State::Idle, ctx)
714	    }
715	
716	    fn on_props_changed(old: &Self::Props, new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event> {
717	        if old == new {
718	            Vec::new()
719	        } else {
720	            vec![Event::SyncProps(Box::new(new.clone()))]
721	        }
722	    }
723	
724	    fn transition(
725	        state: &Self::State,
726	        event: &Self::Event,
727	        ctx: &Self::Context,
728	        _props: &Self::Props,
729	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
730	        if ctx.disabled && !matches!(event, Event::SetValue(_) | Event::SyncProps(_)) {
731	            return None;
732	        }
733	
734	        match event {
735	            Event::SyncProps(props) => {
736	                let props = props.as_ref().clone();
737	                let mut next_ctx = ctx.clone();
738	
739	                sync_props(&mut next_ctx, &props);
740	
741	                let next_state = reconcile_state_after_sync(state, &next_ctx);
742	                let should_apply_focus = next_state != *state;
743	
744	                Some(
745	                    TransitionPlan::to(next_state.clone()).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
746	                        sync_props(ctx, &props);
747	
748	                        if should_apply_focus {
749	                            apply_state_focus(ctx, &next_state);
750	                        }
751	                    }),
752	                )
753	            }
754	
755	            Event::FocusSegment { kind } => {
756	                if !kind.is_editable()
757	                    || !ctx
758	                        .segments
759	                        .iter()
760	                        .any(|segment| segment.kind == *kind && segment.is_editable)
761	                {
762	                    return None;
763	                }
764	
765	                let kind = *kind;
766	                Some(
767	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused(kind)).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
768	                        commit_type_buffer(ctx);
769	                        ctx.focused_segment = Some(kind);
770	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
771	                    }),
772	                )
773	            }
774	
775	            Event::BlurAll => Some(
776	                TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
777	                    .apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {
778	                        commit_type_buffer(ctx);
779	                        ctx.focused_segment = None;
780	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
781	                    })
782	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
783	            ),
784	
785	            Event::FocusNextSegment => {
786	                if let State::Focused(current) = state {
787	                    let current = *current;
788	                    let next = ctx.next_editable_after(current);
789	                    let target = next.map_or(State::Idle, State::Focused);
790	                    Some(
791	                        TransitionPlan::to(target)
792	                            .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
793	                                commit_type_buffer(ctx);
794	                                ctx.focused_segment = next;
795	                                ctx.type_buffer.clear();
796	                            })
797	                            .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
798	                    )
799	                } else {
800	                    let first = ctx.first_editable()?;
801	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused(first)).apply(
802	                        move |ctx: &mut Context| {
803	                            ctx.focused_segment = Some(first);
804	                        },
805	                    ))
806	                }
807	            }
808	
809	            Event::FocusPrevSegment => {
810	                if let State::Focused(current) = state {
811	                    let previous = ctx.prev_editable_before(*current)?;
812	                    Some(
813	                        TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused(previous))
814	                            .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
815	                                commit_type_buffer(ctx);
816	                                ctx.focused_segment = Some(previous);
817	                                ctx.type_buffer.clear();
818	                            })
819	                            .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
820	                    )
821	                } else {
822	                    None
823	                }
824	            }
825	
826	            Event::IncrementSegment { kind } => {
827	                if ctx.readonly {
828	                    return None;
829	                }
830	
831	                let kind = *kind;
832	                Some(
833	                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
834	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
835	                        ctx.increment_segment(kind);
836	                        maybe_publish(ctx);
837	                    })
838	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
839	                )
840	            }
841	
842	            Event::DecrementSegment { kind } => {
843	                if ctx.readonly {
844	                    return None;
845	                }
846	
847	                let kind = *kind;
848	                Some(
849	                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
850	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
851	                        ctx.decrement_segment(kind);
852	                        maybe_publish(ctx);
853	                    })
854	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
855	                )
856	            }
857	
858	            Event::TypeIntoSegment { kind, ch } => {
859	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.is_composing || !matches!(state, State::Focused(_)) {
860	                    return None;
861	                }
862	
863	                type_into_segment(ctx, state, *kind, *ch)
864	            }
865	
866	            Event::TypeBufferCommit { kind } => {
867	                if ctx.readonly {
868	                    return None;
869	                }
870	
871	                let kind = *kind;
872	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
873	                    commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx, kind, true);
874	                }))
875	            }
876	
877	            Event::CompositionStart => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
878	                ctx.is_composing = true;
879	            })),
880	
881	            Event::CompositionEnd { kind, text } => {
882	                let kind = *kind;
883	                let text = text.clone();
884	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
885	                    ctx.is_composing = false;
886	
887	                    if ctx.readonly || ctx.disabled {
888	                        return;
889	                    }
890	
891	                    apply_composed_text(ctx, kind, &text);
892	                }))
893	            }
894	
895	            Event::ClearSegment { kind } => {
896	                if ctx.readonly {
897	                    return None;
898	                }
899	
900	                let kind = *kind;
901	                Some(
902	                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
903	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
904	                        ctx.clear_segment_value(kind);
905	                        ctx.value.set(None);
906	                    })
907	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
908	                )
909	            }
910	
911	            Event::ClearAll => {
912	                if ctx.readonly {
913	                    return None;
914	                }
915	
916	                Some(
917	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
918	                        .apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {
919	                            let editable = ctx
920	                                .segments
921	                                .iter()
922	                                .filter(|segment| segment.is_editable)
923	                                .map(|segment| segment.kind)
924	                                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
925	
926	                            for kind in editable {
927	                                ctx.clear_segment_value(kind);
928	                            }
929	
930	                            ctx.value.set(None);
931	                            ctx.focused_segment = None;
932	                            ctx.type_buffer.clear();
933	                        })
934	                        .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
935	                )
936	            }
937	
938	            Event::SetValue(value) => {
939	                let value = *value;
940	                Some(
941	                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
942	                        apply_value(ctx, value);
943	                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
944	                    })
945	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
946	                )
947	            }
948	        }
949	    }
950	
951	    fn connect<'a>(
952	        state: &'a Self::State,
953	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
954	        props: &'a Self::Props,
955	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
956	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
957	        Api {
958	            state,
959	            ctx,
960	            props,
961	            send,
962	        }
963	    }
964	}
