1027	    /// Creates a `TimeField` connect API from machine state.

1029	    pub const fn new(
1030	        state: &'a State,
1031	        ctx: &'a Context,
1032	        props: &'a Props,

1043	    /// Returns attributes for the outer root element.
1044	    #[must_use]
1045	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
1046	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1047	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
1048	
1049	        attrs
1050	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id())
1051	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1052	            .set(part_attr, part_val)

1054	
1055	        if self.ctx.disabled {

1057	        }
1058	
1059	        if self.ctx.readonly {
1060	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true);
1061	        }
1062	
1063	        if self.props.invalid {
1064	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-invalid"), true);

1069	
1070	    /// Returns attributes for the visible label element.
1071	    #[must_use]
1072	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
1073	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1074	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
1075	
1076	        attrs
1077	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"))
1078	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1079	            .set(part_attr, part_val);
1080	
1081	        attrs
1082	    }
1083	
1084	    /// Returns attributes for the segment group.
1085	    #[must_use]
1086	    pub fn field_group_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
1087	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1088	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::FieldGroup.data_attrs();
1089	
1090	        attrs
1091	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("field-group"))
1092	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group")
1093	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1094	            .set(part_attr, part_val);
1095	
1096	        if let Some(label) = &self.props.aria_label {
1097	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), label);
1098	        } else {
1099	            attrs.set(
1100	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy),
1101	                self.ctx.ids.part("label"),
1102	            );
1103	        }
1104	
1105	        if self.ctx.disabled {
1106	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
1107	        }
1108	
1109	        if self.ctx.readonly {
1110	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), "true");
1111	        }
1112	
1113	        if self.props.invalid {
1114	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), "true");
1115	        }
1116	
1117	        if self.props.required {
1118	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), "true");
1119	        }
1120	
1121	        let mut described_by = Vec::new();
1122	
1123	        if self.props.description.is_some() {
1124	            described_by.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
1125	        }
1126	
1127	        if self.props.invalid && self.props.error_message.is_some() {
1128	            described_by.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
1129	        }
1130	
1131	        if let Some(extra) = &self.props.aria_describedby {
1132	            described_by.push(extra.clone());
1133	        }
1134	
1135	        if !described_by.is_empty() {
1136	            attrs.set(
1137	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy),
1138	                described_by.join(" "),
1139	            );
1140	        }
1141	
1142	        attrs
1143	    }
1144	
1145	    /// Returns attributes for an editable segment or a literal fallback.
1146	    #[must_use]
1147	    pub fn segment_attrs(&self, kind: &DateSegmentKind) -> AttrMap {
1148	        let Some((index, segment)) = self
1149	            .ctx
1150	            .segments
1151	            .iter()
1152	            .enumerate()
1153	            .find(|(_, segment)| segment.kind == *kind)
1154	        else {
1155	            return AttrMap::new();
1156	        };
1157	
1158	        if !segment.is_editable {
1159	            return self.literal_attrs(index);
1160	        }
1161	
1162	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1163	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] =
1164	            (Part::Segment { kind: *kind }).data_attrs();
1165	
1166	        let is_focused = self.ctx.focused_segment == Some(segment.kind);
1167	
1168	        let is_tab_stop = !self.ctx.disabled
1169	            && (is_focused
1170	                || (self.ctx.focused_segment.is_none()
1171	                    && self.ctx.first_editable() == Some(segment.kind)));
1172	
1173	        attrs
1174	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1175	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
1176	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "spinbutton")
1177	            .set(
1178	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
1179	                time_segment_aria_label(segment.kind, &self.ctx.messages, &self.ctx.locale),
1180	            )
1181	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), segment.min.to_string())
1182	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), segment.max.to_string())
1183	            .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-segment"), segment.kind.data_name())
1184	            .set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, if is_tab_stop { "0" } else { "-1" });
1185	
1186	        if let Some(value) = segment.value {
1187	            attrs
1188	                .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), value.to_string())
1189	                .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText), &segment.text);
1190	        } else {
1191	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText), &segment.placeholder);
1192	        }
1193	
1194	        if self.ctx.disabled {
1195	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
1196	        }
1197	
1198	        if self.ctx.readonly {
1199	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), "true");
1200	        }
1201	
1202	        if self.props.invalid && self.props.error_message.is_some() {
1203	            attrs.set(
1204	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy),
1205	                self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"),
1206	            );
1207	        }
1208	
1209	        attrs
1210	    }
1211	
1212	    /// Returns attributes for a literal separator.
1213	    #[must_use]
1214	    pub fn literal_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
1215	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1216	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] =
1217	            (Part::Literal { index }).data_attrs();
1218	
1219	        attrs
1220	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1221	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
1222	            .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-index"), index.to_string())
1223	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Hidden), "true")
1224	            .set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "-1");
1225	
1226	        attrs
1227	    }

1234

1237	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)

1242	
1243	    /// Returns attributes for the error message element.

1248	
1249	        attrs
1250	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"))
1251	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "alert")
1252	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), "polite")
1253	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1254	            .set(part_attr, part_val);
1255	
1256	        attrs

1264	
1265	        let value = self
1266	            .ctx
1267	            .value
1268	            .get()
1269	            .map(|time| time.to_iso8601())
1270	            .unwrap_or_default();
1271	
1272	        attrs
1273	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
1274	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
1275	            .set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden")

1285	    /// Handles focusout on the field group.

1288	            (self.send)(Event::BlurAll);

1292	    /// Handles keydown on a segment.
1293	    pub fn on_segment_keydown(
1294	        &self,
1295	        kind: DateSegmentKind,
1296	        data: &KeyboardEventData,
1297	        shift: bool,
1298	        dir: Direction,
1299	    ) {
1300	        if data.is_composing {
1301	            (self.send)(Event::CompositionStart);
1302	
1303	            return;
1304	        }
1305	
1306	        let is_rtl = dir.is_rtl();
1307	
1308	        match data.key {
1309	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::IncrementSegment { kind }),
1310	
1311	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::DecrementSegment { kind }),
1312	
1313	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight if is_rtl => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),
1314	
1315	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft if is_rtl => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),
1316	
1317	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),
1318	
1319	            KeyboardKey::Tab if shift => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),
1320	
1321	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::Tab => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),
1322	
1323	            KeyboardKey::Backspace | KeyboardKey::Delete => {
1324	                (self.send)(Event::ClearSegment { kind });
1325	            }
1326	
1327	            KeyboardKey::Escape => (self.send)(Event::ClearAll),
1328	
1329	            _ if data.character.is_some() => {
1330	                if let Some(ch) = data.character {
1331	                    (self.send)(Event::TypeIntoSegment { kind, ch });
1332	                }
1333	            }
1334	
1335	            _ => {}
1336	        }
1337	    }

1405	fn type_into_segment(
1406	    ctx: &Context,
1407	    state: &State,
1408	    kind: DateSegmentKind,
1409	    ch: char,
1410	) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {
1411	    if kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod {
1412	        let mut buffer = ctx.type_buffer.clone();
1413	
1414	        buffer.push(ch);
1415	
1416	        let has_cjk_table = cjk_day_period_table(&ctx.locale).is_some();
1417	
1418	        let cjk_value = has_cjk_table
1419	            .then(|| day_period_from_cjk_buffer(&buffer, &ctx.locale, ctx.hour_cycle, None, None))
1420	            .flatten();
1421	
1422	        let backend_value = ctx
1423	            .intl_backend
1424	            .day_period_from_char(ch, &ctx.locale)
1425	            .map(|is_pm| if is_pm { 1 } else { 0 });
1426	
1427	        if has_cjk_table
1428	            && cjk_value.is_none()
1429	            && backend_value.is_none()
1430	            && is_cjk_day_period_prefix(&buffer, &ctx.locale)
1431	        {
1432	            return Some(
1433	                TransitionPlan::to(state.clone())
1434	                    .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
1435	                        ctx.type_buffer = buffer;
1436	                    })
1437	                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit)
1438	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::TypeBufferCommit)),
1439	            );
1440	        }
1441	
1442	        let value = cjk_value.or(backend_value)?;
1443	
1444	        let next = ctx.next_editable_after(kind);
1445	
1446	        let target = next.map_or_else(|| state.clone(), State::Focused);
1447	
1448	        return Some(
1449	            TransitionPlan::to(target)
1450	                .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
1451	                    ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);
1452	
1453	                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1454	
1455	                    if let Some(next) = next {
1456	                        ctx.focused_segment = Some(next);
1457	                    }
1458	
1459	                    maybe_publish(ctx);
1460	                })
1461	                .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),
1462	        );
1463	    }
1464	
1465	    if !matches!(
1466	        kind,
1467	        DateSegmentKind::Hour | DateSegmentKind::Minute | DateSegmentKind::Second
1468	    ) {
1469	        return None;
1470	    }
1471	
1472	    if !ch.is_ascii_digit() {
1473	        return None;
1474	    }
1475	
1476	    let mut new_buffer = ctx.type_buffer.clone();
1477	
1478	    new_buffer.push(ch);
1479	
1480	    let buffered = new_buffer.parse::<i32>().ok()?;
1481	
1482	    let segment = ctx.segments.iter().find(|segment| segment.kind == kind)?;
1483	
1484	    let max_digits = digits_needed(u32::try_from(segment.max).ok()?);
1485	
1486	    let should_advance = new_buffer.len() >= max_digits || buffered * 10 > segment.max;
1487	
1488	    let next = should_advance
1489	        .then(|| ctx.next_editable_after(kind))
1490	        .flatten();
1491	
1492	    let target = if should_advance {
1493	        next.map_or_else(|| state.clone(), State::Focused)
1494	    } else {
1495	        state.clone()
1496	    };
1497	
1498	    let mut plan = TransitionPlan::to(target).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
1499	        ctx.type_buffer.push(ch);
1500	        let Some(segment) = ctx.segments.iter().find(|segment| segment.kind == kind) else {
1501	            return;
1502	        };
1503	
1504	        if let Ok(value) = ctx.type_buffer.parse::<i32>()
1505	            && value >= segment.min
1506	            && value <= segment.max
1507	        {
1508	            ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);
1509	
1510	            maybe_publish(ctx);
1511	        }
1512	
1513	        if should_advance {
1514	            ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1515	
1516	            if let Some(next) = next {
1517	                ctx.focused_segment = Some(next);
1518	            }
1519	        }
1520	    });
1521	
1522	    if should_advance {
1523	        plan = plan.cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit);
1524	    } else {
1525	        plan = plan
1526	            .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit)
1527	            .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::TypeBufferCommit));
1528	    }
1529	
1530	    Some(plan)
1531	}
1532	
1533	fn commit_type_buffer(ctx: &mut Context) {
1534	    if let Some(kind) = ctx.focused_segment {
1535	        commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx, kind, kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod);
1536	    }
1537	}
1538	
1539	fn commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx: &mut Context, kind: DateSegmentKind, timeout_fallback: bool) {
1540	    if kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod {
1541	        if ctx.type_buffer.is_empty() {
1542	            return;
1543	        }
1544	
1545	        let current_hour = timeout_fallback
1546	            .then(|| {
1547	                ctx.get_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Hour)
1548	                    .and_then(|value| u8::try_from(value).ok())
1549	            })
1550	            .flatten();
1551	        let current_day_period = timeout_fallback
1552	            .then(|| ctx.get_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod))
1553	            .flatten();
1554	
1555	        if let Some(value) = day_period_from_cjk_buffer(
1556	            &ctx.type_buffer,
1557	            &ctx.locale,
1558	            ctx.hour_cycle,
1559	            current_hour,
1560	            current_day_period,
1561	        ) {
1562	            ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);
1563	
1564	            maybe_publish(ctx);
1565	        }
1566	
1567	        ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1568	
1569	        return;
1570	    }
1571	
1572	    if let Ok(value) = ctx.type_buffer.parse::<i32>()
1573	        && let Some(segment) = ctx.segments.iter().find(|segment| segment.kind == kind)
1574	        && value >= segment.min
1575	        && value <= segment.max
1576	    {
1577	        ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);
1578	
1579	        maybe_publish(ctx);
1580	    }
1581	
1582	    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1583	}
1584	
1585	fn apply_composed_text(ctx: &mut Context, kind: DateSegmentKind, text: &str) {
1586	    ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1587	
1588	    if kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod {
1589	        if let Some(value) = text.chars().find_map(|ch| {
1590	            ctx.intl_backend
1591	                .day_period_from_char(ch, &ctx.locale)
1592	                .map(|is_pm| if is_pm { 1 } else { 0 })
1593	        }) {
1594	            ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);
1595	            maybe_publish(ctx);
1596	
1597	            return;
1598	        }
1599	
1600	        ctx.type_buffer.push_str(text);
1601	        commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx, kind, true);
1602	
1603	        return;
1604	    }
1605	
1606	    if matches!(
1607	        kind,
1608	        DateSegmentKind::Hour | DateSegmentKind::Minute | DateSegmentKind::Second
1609	    ) {
1610	        ctx.type_buffer
1611	            .extend(text.chars().filter(char::is_ascii_digit));
1612	        commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx, kind, false);
1613	    }
1614	}
1615	
1616	fn maybe_publish(ctx: &mut Context) {
1617	    if !ctx.is_complete() {
1618	        return;
1619	    }
1620	
1621	    let Some(time) = ctx.assemble_time() else {
1622	        return;
1623	    };
1624	
1625	    let clamped = clamp_time(time, ctx.min_value.as_ref(), ctx.max_value.as_ref());
1626	
1627	    apply_segments_from_time(ctx, clamped);
1628	
1629	    ctx.value.set(Some(clamped));
1630	}
1631	
1632	fn apply_value(ctx: &mut Context, value: Option<Time>) {
1633	    let value = value.map(|time| clamp_time(time, ctx.min_value.as_ref(), ctx.max_value.as_ref()));
1634	
1635	    if ctx.value.is_controlled() {
1636	        ctx.value.set(value);
1637	        ctx.value.sync_controlled(Some(value));
1638	    } else {
1639	        ctx.value.set(value);
1640	    }
1641	
1642	    ctx.rebuild_segments();
1643	}
1644	
1645	fn apply_controlled_value(ctx: &mut Context, value: Option<Time>) {
1646	    let value = value.map(|time| clamp_time(time, ctx.min_value.as_ref(), ctx.max_value.as_ref()));
1647	
1648	    ctx.value.set(value);
1649	    ctx.value.sync_controlled(Some(value));
1650	    ctx.rebuild_segments();
1651	}
1652	
1653	fn sync_props(ctx: &mut Context, props: &Props) {
1654	    let was_controlled = ctx.value.is_controlled();
1655	    let previous_granularity = ctx.granularity;
1656	    let previous_hour_cycle = ctx.hour_cycle;
1657	    let previous_force_leading_zeros = ctx.force_leading_zeros;
1658	
1659	    ctx.granularity = props.granularity;
1660	    ctx.hour_cycle = props
1661	        .hour_cycle
1662	        .unwrap_or_else(|| ctx.locale.hour_cycle(ctx.intl_backend.as_ref()));
1663	    ctx.disabled = props.disabled;
1664	    ctx.readonly = props.readonly;
1665	    ctx.min_value = props.min_value;
1666	    ctx.max_value = props.max_value;
1667	    ctx.ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
1668	    ctx.force_leading_zeros = props.force_leading_zeros;
1669	
1670	    if let Some(value) = props.value {
1671	        apply_controlled_value(ctx, value);
1672	    } else if was_controlled {
1673	        ctx.value.sync_controlled(None);
1674	        ctx.value.set(None);
1675	        ctx.rebuild_segments();
1676	    } else {
1677	        ctx.value.sync_controlled(None);
1678	
1679	        let clamped = ctx
1680	            .value
1681	            .get()
1682	            .map(|time| clamp_time(time, ctx.min_value.as_ref(), ctx.max_value.as_ref()));
1683	        let value_changed = clamped != *ctx.value.get();
1684	        let must_rebuild = previous_granularity != ctx.granularity
1685	            || previous_hour_cycle != ctx.hour_cycle
1686	            || previous_force_leading_zeros != ctx.force_leading_zeros
1687	            || value_changed;
1688	
1689	        ctx.value.set(clamped);
1690	
1691	        if must_rebuild {
1692	            ctx.rebuild_segments();
1693	        }
1694	    }
1695	}
1696	
1697	fn reconcile_state_after_sync(state: &State, ctx: &Context) -> State {
1698	    let State::Focused(kind) = state else {
1699	        return State::Idle;
1700	    };
1701	
1702	    let still_focusable = !ctx.disabled
1703	        && ctx
1704	            .segments
1705	            .iter()
1706	            .any(|segment| segment.kind == *kind && segment.is_editable);
1707	
1708	    if still_focusable {
1709	        State::Focused(*kind)
1710	    } else {
1711	        State::Idle
1712	    }
1713	}
1714	
1715	fn apply_state_focus(ctx: &mut Context, state: &State) {
1716	    match state {
1717	        State::Idle => {
1718	            ctx.focused_segment = None;
1719	            ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1720	        }
1721	
1722	        State::Focused(kind) => {
1723	            ctx.focused_segment = Some(*kind);
1724	            ctx.type_buffer.clear();
1725	        }
1726	    }
1727	}
1728	
1729	fn apply_segments_from_time(ctx: &mut Context, time: Time) {
1730	    for segment in &mut ctx.segments {
1731	        let value = match segment.kind {
1732	            DateSegmentKind::Hour => Some(display_hour(time, ctx.hour_cycle)),
1733	            DateSegmentKind::Minute => Some(i32::from(time.minute())),
1734	            DateSegmentKind::Second => Some(i32::from(time.second())),
1735	            DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod => Some(if is_pm(time) { 1 } else { 0 }),
1736	            _ => None,
1737	        };
1738	
1739	        if let Some(value) = value {
1740	            segment.value = Some(value);
1741	
1742	            segment.text = format_time_segment(
1743	                ctx.intl_backend.as_ref(),
1744	                &ctx.locale,
1745	                segment.kind,
1746	                value,
1747	                ctx.force_leading_zeros,
1748	            );
1749	        }
1750	    }
1751	}
1752	
1753	fn build_segments(ctx: &Context) -> Vec<DateSegment> {
1754	    let mut segments = Vec::new();
1755	
1756	    let value = *ctx.value.get();
1757	
1758	    let (hour_min, hour_max) = display_hour_range(ctx.hour_cycle);
1759	
1760	    let mut hour = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Hour, hour_min, hour_max, "hh");
1761	
1762	    if let Some(time) = value {
1763	        let display = display_hour(time, ctx.hour_cycle);
1764	
1765	        hour.value = Some(display);
1766	        hour.text = ctx.format_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Hour, display);
1767	    }
1768	
1769	    segments.push(hour);
1770	
1771	    if ctx.granularity >= TimeGranularity::Minute {
1772	        segments.push(DateSegment::new_literal(":"));
1773	
1774	        let mut minute = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Minute, 0, 59, "mm");
1775	
1776	        if let Some(time) = value {
1777	            let value = i32::from(time.minute());
1778	
1779	            minute.value = Some(value);
1780	            minute.text = ctx.format_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Minute, value);
1781	        }
1782	
1783	        segments.push(minute);
1784	    }
1785	
1786	    if ctx.granularity >= TimeGranularity::Second {
1787	        segments.push(DateSegment::new_literal(":"));
1788	
1789	        let mut second = DateSegment::new_numeric(DateSegmentKind::Second, 0, 59, "ss");
1790	
1791	        if let Some(time) = value {
1792	            let value = i32::from(time.second());
1793	
1794	            second.value = Some(value);
1795	            second.text = ctx.format_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Second, value);
1796	        }
1797	
1798	        segments.push(second);
1799	    }
1800	
1801	    if has_day_period(ctx.hour_cycle) {
1802	        segments.push(DateSegment::new_literal("\u{00A0}"));
1803	
1804	        let mut period = DateSegment {
1805	            kind: DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod,
1806	            value: None,
1807	            min: 0,
1808	            max: 1,
1809	            text: String::new(),
1810	            placeholder: ctx.intl_backend.day_period_label(false, &ctx.locale),
1811	            literal: None,
1812	            is_editable: true,
1813	        };
1814	
1815	        if let Some(time) = value {
1816	            let value = if is_pm(time) { 1 } else { 0 };
1817	
1818	            period.value = Some(value);
1819	            period.text = ctx.format_segment_value(DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod, value);
1820	        }
1821	
1822	        segments.push(period);
1823	    }
1824	
1825	    segments
1826	}
1827	
1828	const fn display_hour_range(hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> (i32, i32) {
1829	    match hour_cycle {
1830	        HourCycle::H11 => (0, 11),
1831	        HourCycle::H12 => (1, 12),
1832	        HourCycle::H23 => (0, 23),
1833	        HourCycle::H24 => (1, 24),
1834	    }
1835	}
1836	
1837	const fn has_day_period(hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> bool {
1838	    matches!(hour_cycle, HourCycle::H11 | HourCycle::H12)
1839	}
1840	
1841	fn display_hour(time: Time, hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> i32 {
1842	    let hour = time.hour();
1843	
1844	    match hour_cycle {
1845	        HourCycle::H11 => i32::from(hour % 12),
1846	
1847	        HourCycle::H12 => i32::from(if hour.is_multiple_of(12) {
1848	            12
1849	        } else {
1850	            hour % 12
1851	        }),
1852	
1853	        HourCycle::H23 => i32::from(hour),
1854	
1855	        HourCycle::H24 => i32::from(if hour == 0 { 24 } else { hour }),
1856	    }
1857	}
1858	
1859	fn display_hour_to_24(raw_hour: u8, day_period: Option<i32>, hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> Option<u8> {
1860	    match hour_cycle {
1861	        HourCycle::H11 => {
1862	            let is_pm = day_period.unwrap_or(0) == 1;
1863	            Some(if is_pm { raw_hour + 12 } else { raw_hour })
1864	        }
1865	
1866	        HourCycle::H12 => {
1867	            let is_pm = day_period.unwrap_or(0) == 1;
1868	            Some(match (raw_hour, is_pm) {
1869	                (12, false) => 0,
1870	                (12, true) => 12,
1871	                (_, true) => raw_hour + 12,

703	/// The focus move that should accompany an open/close once it actually lands.
704	///
705	/// Recorded per user event so a controlled-`open` reconciliation (which lands
706	/// the state change later, in `SyncProps`) can reproduce the *originating*
707	/// intent instead of always focusing the calendar on open / the trigger on
708	/// close. Internal: the adapter only ever sees the resulting focus `Effect`.
709	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
710	enum OpenFocus {
711	    /// Move focus into the calendar (trigger / `ArrowDown` open).
712	    Calendar,
713	    /// Restore focus to the trigger (`Close` / Escape).
714	    Trigger,
715	    /// Restore focus to the input (`SelectDate` close).
716	    Input,
717	    /// Do not move focus (input-focus open, focus-out close).
718	    None,
719	}
720	
721	impl OpenFocus {
722	    fn effect(self) -> Option<PendingEffect<Machine>> {
723	        match self {
724	            OpenFocus::Calendar => Some(focus_calendar_effect()),
725	            OpenFocus::Trigger => Some(restore_focus_to_trigger_effect()),
726	            OpenFocus::Input => Some(restore_focus_to_input_effect()),
727	            OpenFocus::None => None,

732	/// Builds the plan for a user-driven request to open or close the popover.
733	///
734	/// When `open` is **controlled** (`props.open.is_some()`), the [`State`] is not
735	/// mutated: the request is recorded in [`Context::requested_open`] (and the
736	/// `focus` intent in `requested_focus`) and signalled via [`Effect::OpenChange`]
737	/// so the parent reconciles by updating the `open` prop — the focus effect then
738	/// fires from `SyncProps` once the state actually lands. When **uncontrolled**,
739	/// the `State` transitions and the `focus` effect fires immediately.
740	///
741	/// Returns `None` when the popover is already in the requested open state.
742	fn open_request(
743	    state: &State,
744	    ctx: &Context,
745	    props: &Props,
746	    target_open: bool,
747	    focus: OpenFocus,
748	) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {
749	    if (*state == State::Open) == target_open {
750	        // Already in the requested open-state, so there is nothing to
751	        // reconcile. A controlled open the parent vetoed (left `open`
752	        // unchanged) leaves a deferred focus intent in `requested_focus` with no
753	        // `SyncProps` to consume it; a subsequent no-op *close* (e.g. `FocusOut`
754	        // after the input lost focus) cancels that stale intent so a later
755	        // programmatic open uses the per-direction default (`FocusCalendar`)
756	        // instead of suppressing it. (`requested_focus` is only ever set under
757	        // controlled `open`, so the uncontrolled no-op path stays a pure `None`.)
758	        if !target_open && ctx.requested_focus.is_some() {
759	            return Some(TransitionPlan::new().apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {
760	                ctx.requested_focus = None;
761	            }));
762	        }
763	        return None;
764	    }
765	
766	    let controlled = props.open.is_some();
767	    let mut plan = if controlled {
768	        TransitionPlan::new()
769	    } else {
770	        TransitionPlan::to(if target_open {
771	            State::Open
772	        } else {
773	            State::Closed
774	        })
775	    };
776	
777	    plan = plan
778	        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
779	            ctx.requested_open = target_open;
780	            if controlled {
781	                // Defer the focus move to `SyncProps`, which lands the state.
782	                ctx.requested_focus = Some(focus);
783	            }
784	        })
785	        .with_effect(open_change_effect());
786	
787	    if !controlled && let Some(focus) = focus.effect() {
788	        plan = plan.with_effect(focus);
789	    }
790	
791	    Some(plan)
792	}

  "content": "//! Hour-cycle math and numeric-segment helpers shared by the segmented\n//! date/time inputs (`time_field`, `date_time_picker`).\n//!\n//! These functions translate between a [`Time`]'s underlying 24-hour value and\n//! the value displayed in an hour segment for a given [`HourCycle`], decide\n//! whether a day-period (AM/PM) segment is required, and report the width of a\n//! numeric segment's type-ahead buffer. They are deliberately free functions so\n//! both the standalone `TimeField` and the composite `DateTimePicker` resolve\n//! hour-cycle display identically from a single source of truth.\n\nuse ars_i18n::{HourCycle, Time};\n\n/// Returns the inclusive `(min, max)` hour range displayed for `hour_cycle`.\npub(crate) const fn display_hour_range(hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> (i32, i32) {\n    match hour_cycle {\n        HourCycle::H11 => (0, 11),\n        HourCycle::H12 => (1, 12),\n        HourCycle::H23 => (0, 23),\n        HourCycle::H24 => (1, 24),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Returns `true` when `hour_cycle` requires a day-period (AM/PM) segment.\npub(crate) const fn has_day_period(hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> bool {\n    matches!(hour_cycle, HourCycle::H11 | HourCycle::H12)\n}\n\n/// Converts a [`Time`]'s 24-hour value into the value shown in an hour segment.\npub(crate) fn display_hour(time: Time, hour_cycle: HourCycle) -> i32 {\n    let hour = time.hour();\n\n    match hour_cycle {\n        HourCycle::H11 => i32::from(hour % 12),\n\n        HourCycle::H12 => i32::from(if hour.is_multiple_of(12) {\n            12\n        } else {\n            hour % 12\n        }),\n\n        HourCycle::H23 => i32::from(hour),\n\n        HourCycle::H24 => i32::from(if hour == 0 { 24 } else { hour }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Converts a displayed hour value (plus optional day-period) back to 24-hour.\n///\n/// `day_period` is `Some(1)` for PM, `Some(0)` for AM, or `None` when the cycle\n/// has no day-period segment. Returns `None` only if the inputs cannot form a\n/// valid 24-hour value.\npub(crate) fn display_hour_to_24(\n    raw_hour: u8,\n    day_period: Option<i32>,\n    hour_cycle: HourCycle,\n) -> Option<u8> {\n    match hour_cycle {\n        HourCycle::H11 => {\n            let is_pm = day_period.unwrap_or(0) == 1;\n            Some(if is_pm { raw_hour + 12 } else { raw_hour })\n        }\n\n        HourCycle::H12 => {\n            let is_pm = day_period.unwrap_or(0) == 1;\n            Some(match (raw_hour, is_pm) {\n                (12, false) => 0,\n                (12, true) => 12,\n                (_, true) => raw_hour + 12,\n                (_, false) => raw_hour,\n            })\n        }\n\n        HourCycle::H23 => Some(raw_hour),\n\n        HourCycle::H24 => Some(if raw_hour == 24 { 0 } else { raw_hour }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Returns `true` when the time falls in the afternoon (hour >= 12).\npub(crate) const fn is_pm(time: Time) -> bool {\n    time.hour() >= 12\n}\n\n/// Returns the number of decimal digits needed to represent `max`.\n///\n/// Used by numeric segment type-ahead to decide when a buffered entry is \"full\"\n/// and focus should auto-advance to the next segment.\npub(crate) const fn digits_needed(max: u32) -> usize {\n    match max {\n        0..=9 => 1,\n        10..=99 => 2,\n        100..=999 => 3,\n        _ => 4,\n    }\n}\n"
}

Like the sibling `date_picker`/`time_field` machines, this machine never\n//! performs DOM focus moves itself. It emits typed [`Effect`] intents via\n//! [`PendingEffect::named`]; the adapter dispatches the real focus operation\n//! (move focus into the calendar, restore focus to the trigger, focus the first\n//! time segment, start the type-ahead commit timer) on each named effect using\n//! live element handles. Stable string IDs are used only for semantic ARIA\n//! relationships and `data-ars-*` hooks, not as a substitute for live handles.\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests;\n\nuse alloc::{\n    boxed::Box,\n    format,\n    string::{String, ToString},\n    sync::Arc,\n    vec,\n    vec::Vec,\n};\nuse core::{\n    cmp::Ordering,\n    fmt::{self, Debug},\n};\n\nuse ars_core::{\n    AriaAttr, AttrMap, Bindable, ComponentIds, ComponentMessages, ComponentPart, ConnectApi,\n    Direction, Env, HtmlAttr, IntlBackend, KeyboardKey, Locale, MessageFn, PendingEffect,\n    TransitionPlan,\n};\nuse ars_i18n::{CalendarDate, CalendarDateTime, CalendarSystem, DateOrder, HourCycle, Time, date_order};\nuse ars_interactions::KeyboardEventData;\n\nuse super::calendar;\nuse super::date_field::segment::{DateSegment, DateSegmentKind};\nuse super::hour_cycle::{\n    digits_needed, display_hour, display_hour_range, display_hour_to_24, has_day_period, is_pm,\n};\nuse super::time_field::TimeGranularity;\n\n/// States for the `DateTimePicker` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum State {\n    /// Idle; no segment has focus and the popover is closed.\n    Idle,\n\n    /// A segment (date or time) has focus; the popover is closed.\n    Focused,\n\n    /// The calendar popover is open.\n    Open,\n}\n\n/// Events for the `DateTimePicker` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub enum Event {\n    /// Open the calendar popover.\n    Open,\n\n    /// Close the calendar popover.\n    Close,\n\n    /// Toggle the calendar messages.clone(),\n            intl_backend: Arc::clone(&env.intl_backend),\n            granularity: props.granularity,\n            hour_cycle,\n            calendar: props.calendar,\n            min_value: props.min_value.clone(),\n            max_value: props.max_value.clone(),\n            disabled: props.disabled,\n            readonly: props.readonly,\n            is_touched: false,\n            required: props.required,\n            invalid: props.invalid,\n            name: props.name.clone(),\n            is_rtl: props.is_rtl,\n            today: props.today.clone(),\n            visible_months: props.visible_months,\n            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),\n        };\n\n        (State::Idle, ctx)\n    }\n\n    fn on_props_changed(old: &Self::Props, new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event> {\n        if old == new {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            vec![Event::SyncProps(Box::new(new.clone()))]\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn transition(\n        state: &Self::State,\n        event: &Self::Event,\n        ctx: &Self::Context,\n        props: &Self::Props,\n    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {\n        // `SyncProps` flows through even when disabled so parent-driven changes\n        // that take the picker out of the disabled state can land.\n        if let Event::SyncProps(new_props) = event {\n            let new_props = new_props.as_ref().clone();\n            let mut probe = ctx.clone();\n            sync_props(&mut probe, &new_props);\n            let next_state = reconcile_state_after_sync(state, &probe);\n            let clear_focus = next_state != *state && next_state == State::Idle;\n\n            return Some(\n                TransitionPlan::to(next_state).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    sync_props(ctx, &new_props);\n                    if clear_focus {\n                        ctx.focused_segment = None;\n                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                    }\n                }),\n            );\n        }\n\n        if ctx.disabled {\n            return None;\n        }\n\n        match event {\n            Event::Open => {\n                if *state == State::Open || ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Open)\n                        .apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            ctx.open = true;\n                        })\n                        .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::FocusCalendar)),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::Close => {\n                if *state != State::Open {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n                        .apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            ctx.open = false;\n                        })\n                        .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::RestoreFocusToTrigger)),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::Toggle => match state {\n                State::Open => Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props),\n                _ => Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props),\n            },\n\n            Event::CalendarSelectDate(date) => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let date = date.clone();\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n                        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            ctx.date_value = Some(date.clone());\n                            ctx.open = false;\n                            ctx.is_touched = true;\n                            ctx.rebuild_date_segments();\n                            Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);\n                        })\n                        .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::FocusFirstTimeSegment)),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::FocusSegment(kind) => {\n                let kind = *kind;\n                if !ctx.segment(kind).is_some_and(|segment| segment.is_editable) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n                        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            commit_type_buffer(ctx);\n                            ctx.focused_segment = Some(kind);\n                            ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                        })\n                        .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::FocusNextSegment => match ctx.focused_segment {\n                Some(current) => {\n                    let next = ctx.next_editable_after(current);\n                    Some(\n                        TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n                            .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                                commit_type_buffer(ctx);\n                                ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                                if let Some(next) = next {\n                                    ctx.focused_segment = Some(next);\n                                }\n                            })\n                            .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                    )\n                }\n                None => {\n                    let first = ctx.first_editable()?;\n                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.focused_segment = Some(first);\n                    }))\n                }\n            },\n\n            Event::FocusPrevSegment => {\n                let current = ctx.focused_segment?;\n                let previous = ctx.prev_editable_before(current)?;\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n                        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            commit_type_buffer(ctx);\n                            ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                            ctx.focused_segment = Some(previous);\n                        })\n                        .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::IncrementSegment { segment } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let kind = *segment;\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                        ctx.increment_segment(kind);\n                        ctx.is_touched = true;\n                        sync_sub_value(ctx, kind);\n                        Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);\n                    })\n                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::DecrementSegment { segment } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let kind = *segment;\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                        ctx.decrement_segment(kind);\n                        ctx.is_touched = true;\n                        sync_sub_value(ctx, kind);\n                        Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);\n                    })\n                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::TypeIntoSegment { segment, ch } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                type_into_segment(ctx, *segment, *ch)\n            }\n\n            Event::TypeBufferCommit { segment } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let kind = *segment;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    commit_buffer_for_kind(ctx, kind);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::SegmentChange { segment, value } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let kind = *segment;\n                let value = *value;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.set_segment_value(kind, value);\n                    ctx.is_touched = true;\n                    sync_sub_value(ctx, kind);\n                    Machine::maybe_publish(ctx);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::ValueCommit(datetime) => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let datetime = datetime.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    apply_value(ctx, datetime.clone());\n                    ctx.is_touched = true;\n                    ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::ClearSegment { segment } => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let kind = *segment;\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                        ctx.clear_segment_value(kind);\n                        sync_sub_value(ctx, kind);\n                        ctx.value.set(None);\n                    })\n                    .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::ClearAll => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)\n                        .apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            let editable = ctx\n                                .all_segments()\n                                .filter(|segment| segment.is_editable)\n                                .map(|segment| segment.kind)\n                                .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n                            for kind in editable {\n                                ctx.clear_segment_value(kind);\n                            }\n                            ctx.date_value = None;\n                            ctx.time_value = None;\n                            ctx.value.set(None);\n                            ctx.focused_segment = None;\n                            ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                        })\n                        .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::FocusIn => {\n                if *state == State::Idle {\n                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused))\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            }\n\n            Event::FocusOut => {\n                let was_open = ctx.open;\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)\n                        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                            commit_type_buffer(ctx);\n                            ctx.focused_segment = None;\n                            ctx.type_buffer.clear();\n                            if was_open {\n                                ctx.open = false;\n                            }\n                        })\n                        .cancel_effect(Effect::TypeBufferCommit),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::KeyDown { key } => match key {\n                KeyboardKey::Escape if *state == State::Open => {\n                    Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props)\n                }\n                KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if *state != State::Open => {\n                    Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props)\n                }\n                _ => None,\n            },\n\n            // Handled above the disabled guard.\n            Event::SyncProps(_) => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a Self::State,\n        ctx: &'a Self::Context,\n        props: &'a Self::Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),\n    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {\n        Api {\n            state,\n            ctx,\n            props,\n            send,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Structural parts exposed by the `DateTimePicker` connect API.\n#[derive(ComponentPart)]\n#[scope = \"date-time-picker\"]\npub enum Part {\n    /// The outermost container.\n    Root,\n\n    /// The associated label.\n    Label,\n\n    /// The control group wrapping the segments, trigger, and clear button.\n    Control,\n\n    /// The group containing all date segments.\n    DateSegmentGroup,\n\n    /// The group containing all time segments.\n    TimeSegmentGroup,\n\n    /// An editable date or time segment.\n    Segment {\n        /// The logical kind of the segment.\n        kind: DateSegmentKind,\n    },\n\n    /// A non-editable literal separator within a segment group.\n    Literal {\n        /// The literal's rendered index.\n        index: usize,\n    },\n\n    /// The visual separator between the date and time groups.\n    Separator,\n\n    /// The button that toggles the calendar popover.\n    Trigger,\n\n    /// The button that clears the value; hidden when empty.\n    ClearTrigger,\n\n    /// The floating positioner for the popover content.\n    Positioner,\n\n    /// The popover content (`role=\"dialog\"`) containing the embedded calendar.\n    Content,\n\n    /// Optional help text.\n    Description,\n\n    /// component.\npub struct Api<'a> {\n    /// The state of the component.\n    state: &'a State,\n\n    /// The context of the component.\n    ctx: &'a Context,\n\n    /// The props of the component.\n    props: &'a Props,\n\n    /// The send function.\n    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),\n}\n\nimpl Debug for Api<'_> {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"Api\")\n            .field(\"state\", self.state)\n            .field(\"ctx\", self.ctx)\n            .field(\"props\", self.props)\n            .finish_non_exhaustive()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<'a> Api<'a> {\n    /// Creates a `DateTimePicker` connect API from machine state.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub const fn new(\n        state: &'a State,\n        ctx: &'a Context,\n attributes for the root element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id())\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n true);\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.is_rtl {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Dir, \"rtl\");\n        }\n\n        if let Some(announcement) = format_announcement(self.ctx) {\n scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"label\"))\n            .set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part(\"control\"));\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Returns attributes for the control wrapper element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn control_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Control.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"control\"))\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"group\")\n described_by.push(self.ctx.ids.part(\"error-message\"));\n        }\n\n        if !described_by.is_empty() {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), described_by.join(\" \"));\n        }\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Returns attributes for the date segment group.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn date_segment_group_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), \"true\");\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.readonly {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), \"true\");\n        }\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Returns attributes for a literal separator within a segment group.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn literal_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = Returns attributes for the separator between the date and time groups.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn separator_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::IncrementSegment { segment: kind }),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if data.alt_key => (self.send)(Event::Open),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::Tab if data.shift_key =>   "new_string": "`DateTimePicker` is a composite component that combines a `DatePicker` (segmented date input with calendar popover) and a `TimeField` (segmented time input) into a single control for selecting both date and time. The date segments and time segments render in a unified control area, separated by a visual separator. The calendar popover handles date selection; time segments are edited inline via the spinbutton pattern.\n\n> **Spec-vs-implementation reconciliation.** The code blocks below describe the\n> agnostic implementation at `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/`,\n> which is the authoritative contract. Key conventions, shared with the sibling\n> `date_picker`/`time_field` machines:\n>\n> - **Combined value is `ars_i18n::CalendarDateTime`** (`CalendarDateTime::new(date, time)`,\n>   accessors `.date()`/`.time()`). It has no `Ord`, so range checks compare the\n>   date via `CalendarDate::compare` and then the `Time` via `Ord`.\n> - **Focus is adapter-driven via named effects.** The machine declares a typed\n>   `Effect` enum and emits [`PendingEffect::named`] intents (`FocusCalendar`,\n>   `RestoreFocusToTrigger`, `FocusFirstTimeSegment`, `TypeBufferCommit`); the\n>   adapter performs the live, element-handle-based focus / timer. The core never\n>   calls `use_platform_effects()`/`focus_element_by_id` (matches the element/ref\n>   handling note in issue #292).\n> - **Controlled-prop sync.** `on_props_changed` emits `Event::SyncProps(Box<Props>)`,\n>   which reconciles the controlled `value` and cached scalar fields and flows\n>   through even when `disabled` so a parent can lift the disabled state.\n> - **Segment helpers are shared.** Hour-cycle math (`display_hour`,\n>   `display_hour_to_24`, `display_hour_range`, `has_day_period`, `is_pm`) and the\n>   `digits_needed` type-ahead helper live in `date_time::hour_cycle`, shared with\n>   `time_field`. Date segment order comes from `ars_i18n::date_order`. Segment\n>   ARIA labels resolve from the per-segment fields on this component's `Messages`.\n> - **Real `CalendarDate`/`Time` APIs.** `CalendarDate::new_gregorian(year: i32,\n>   month: u8, day: u8)` and `Time::new(h, m, s, millis)` are fallible; segment\n>   values pass through `.ok()`. Segment kinds expose `data_name()` (not `as_str()`).\n\n## 1. State Machine"
}

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-292/spec/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md",
  "old_string": "    /// Handle keydown on a segment (date or time).\n    pub fn on_segment_keydown(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind, key: KeyboardKey) {\n        match key {\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp   => (self.send)(Event::IncrementSegment { segment: kind }),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::DecrementSegment { segment: kind }),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::Backspace | KeyboardKey::Delete => {\n                (self.send)(Event::ClearSegment { segment: kind })\n            }\n            KeyboardKey::Char(ch) => {\n                (self.send)(Event::TypeIntoSegment { segment: kind, ch })\n            }\n            KeyboardKey::Escape => (self.send)(Event::KeyDown { key }),\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }",
  "new_string": "    /// Handle keydown on a segment (date or time).\n    ///\n    /// Typed characters arrive via `KeyboardEventData::character` (there is no\n    /// `KeyboardKey::Char` variant). `dir` flips Arrow Left/Right for RTL, and\n    /// `Alt+ArrowDown` opens the popover.\n    pub fn on_segment_keydown(&self, kind: DateSegmentKind, data: &KeyboardEventData, dir: Direction) {\n        let is_rtl = dir.is_rtl();\n        match data.key {\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::IncrementSegment { segment: kind }),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if data.alt_key => (self.send)(Event::Open),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::DecrementSegment { segment: kind }),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight if is_rtl => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft if is_rtl => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::Tab if data.shift_key => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::Tab => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextSegment),\n            KeyboardKey::Backspace | KeyboardKey::Delete => {\n                (self.send)(Event::ClearSegment { segment: kind })\n            }\n            KeyboardKey::Escape => (self.send)(Event::KeyDown { key: data.key }),\n            _ if data.character.is_some() => {\n                if let Some(ch) = data.character {\n                    (self.send)(Event::TypeIntoSegment { segment: kind, ch });\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }"
}

=== time_field proptest invariant block (lines 224-300) to mirror ===
    #[test]
    #[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]
    fn proptest_time_field_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(
        actions in prop::collection::vec(arb_time_field_action(), 0..128),
    ) {
        let mut service = Service::<time_field::Machine>::new(
            time_field_props(),
            &Env::default(),
            &time_field::Messages::default(),
        );

        for action in actions {
            match action {
                TimeFieldAction::Send(event) => {
                    drop(service.send(event));
                }

                TimeFieldAction::SetControlledValue(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(time_field_props().value(value)));
                }

                TimeFieldAction::SetDisabled(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(time_field_props().disabled(value)));
                }

                TimeFieldAction::SetReadonly(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(time_field_props().readonly(value)));
                }

                TimeFieldAction::SetInvalid(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(time_field_props().invalid(value)));
                }
            }

            let ctx = service.context();

            prop_assert_eq!(ctx.ids.id(), "time-field");

            for segment in &ctx.segments {
                prop_assert!(segment.min <= segment.max);

                if let Some(value) = segment.value {
                    prop_assert!(value >= segment.min);
                    prop_assert!(value <= segment.max);
                }
            }

            if matches!(ctx.hour_cycle, HourCycle::H23 | HourCycle::H24) {
                prop_assert!(
                    !ctx.segments
                        .iter()
                        .any(|segment| segment.kind == DateSegmentKind::DayPeriod)
                );
            }

            match service.state() {
                time_field::State::Idle => {}

                time_field::State::Focused(kind) => {
                    prop_assert!(kind.is_editable());
                    prop_assert_eq!(ctx.focused_segment, Some(*kind));
                }
            }

            if ctx.type_buffer.is_empty()
                && !ctx.value.is_controlled()
                && let Some(value) = ctx.value.get()
            {
                prop_assert_eq!(
                    ctx.segments
                        .iter()
                        .find(|segment| segment.kind == DateSegmentKind::Hour)
                        .and_then(|segment| segment.value),
                    Some(match ctx.hour_cycle {
                        HourCycle::H11 => i32::from(value.hour() % 12),
                        HourCycle::H12 => i32::from(if value.hour() % 12 == 0 { 12 } else { value.hour() % 12 }),
                        HourCycle::H23 => i32::from(value.hour()),
                        HourCycle::H24 => i32::from(if value.hour() == 0 { 24 } else { value.hour() }),
                    })
                );
            }
        }

> AGENT

Task #292 (DateTimePicker agnostic core) is implemented, audited, and verified. Here's the consolidated result for your review.

## What was built

A unified `DateTimePicker` state machine that fuses segmented date input (DateField-style), segmented time input (TimeField-style), and a calendar popover + trigger (DatePicker-style) into one machine producing a combined `CalendarDateTime`.

**New files**
- [crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs) — `State`/`Event`/`Context`/`Props`/`Messages`/`Effect`/`Part`/`Api`, builders, `connect()`.
- [crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/tests.rs](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/tests.rs) — 99 unit + snapshot tests.
- 34 committed `.snap` fixtures under `…/date_time_picker/snapshots/`.
- [crates/ars-components/src/date_time/hour_cycle.rs](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/hour_cycle.rs) — shared hour-cycle/`digits_needed` helpers (your "promote to shared module" decision).

**Modified**
- [time_field/mod.rs](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/time_field/mod.rs) — now imports the promoted helpers (50 tests still green, 98.67% coverage).
- [date_time/mod.rs](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/mod.rs) — module declarations.
- [spec/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md](spec/components/date-time/date-time-picker.md) — synced §1.2–1.8 + §4.1 to the real API.
- Both adapter specs — `DateTime` → `CalendarDateTime`.
- [spec_conformance/date_time.rs](crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/date_time.rs) + [proptest_state_machines/date_time.rs](crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/date_time.rs) — new entries.

## Spec drift resolved (the spec was heavily drifted)

The spec's `DateTimePicker` §1.3/§1.7/§1.8 was idealized pseudo-code that wouldn't compile: nonexistent `DateTime` type, `<`/`>` on non-`Ord` dates, `PendingEffect::new(closure)` + `use_platform_effects()`, `NonZero` months, 3-arg `Time::new`, `kind.as_str()`/no-arg `aria_label()`. I rewrote it to the real conventions (typed `Effect` enum + `PendingEffect::named`, `CalendarDateTime`, `CalendarDate::compare`, `date_order`, the shared `hour_cycle` helpers, per-segment label fields on `Messages` per your decision) and added a reconciliation note matching the sibling specs.

## Audit findings (all landed in this PR)

- **Phase 1 (drift):** 2 spec-doc fixes — `Control` carries `aria-describedby` (not the hidden, non-focusable input); fixed the §3.1 accessibility table.
- **Phase 2 R1:** added the mandatory spec-conformance test; corrected adapter-spec value type. **R2:** added state-machine proptest (parity with all date-time siblings). R3/R4 clean.
- **Phase 3 (coverage):** raised dtp `mod.rs` from **79% → 91.49% lines / 95.24% functions** (above the 90/90 gate); `hour_cycle.rs` 100%. Added behavior tests for builders, `Debug`, the `set_props`/`on_props_changed`/`SyncProps` path, `ValueCommit(None)`, second-granularity + H23 announcements, readonly segments, and Api dispatch.

| dtp proptest (`--ignored`, 64 cases) | passed |
| `cargo insta test --unreferenced=reject` (workspace) | no unreferenced snapshots |
| workspace clippy `-D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask spec validate` + snippet compile | passed |
| i18n-feature dtp tests + adapter builds | passed |

> AGENT

Answered by the search: **there is no single canonical "date separator from locale" helper.** The same heuristic is duplicated in three places, and they don't fully agree:

| Location | de-DE | ko-KR | else |
|---|---|---|---|
| [date_picker `default_format_for_locale`](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_picker/mod.rs#L425) | `.` | `.` | `/` |
| [date_field `literal_for_locale`](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_field/mod.rs#L2253) | `.` | `. ` (dot+space) | `/` |
| my [`date_separator`](crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs#L2250) | `.` | `.` | `/` |

So mine is a third copy, identical to DatePicker's but differing from DateField's ko-KR spacing.

The actual CLDR-backed source of truth does exist — `ars_i18n::DateFormatter` emits `DateFormatterPartKind::Literal` parts ([date.rs:288](crates/ars-i18n/src/date.rs#L288)) — but no component uses it for segment separators; they all use the cheap `(language, region)` heuristic instead (matching the spec's stated "small locale heuristic" intent, and `date_order` already provides the field order separately).

This duplication/inconsistency **predates #292** (DatePicker + DateField shipped it); my task just added the third copy. Fixing it well is a small cross-component refactor. How would you like me to handle it within this PR?

fn icu_date_order(locale: &Locale) -> Option<DateOrder> {
    let probe = CalendarDate::new_gregorian(2006, 11, 22).ok()?;

    // Force the Gregorian calendar so non-Gregorian-default locales (e.g. the
    // Solar Hijri default for `fa-IR`) keep the probe's recognisable
    // year/month/day values instead of converting them away.
    let locale = locale.with_gregorian_calendar();

    let formatter = build_icu_date_formatter(&locale, FormatLength::Short);

    let formatted = format_icu_date(&locale, FormatLength::Short, &formatter, &probe);

    numeric_field_order_from_formatted(&formatted)
}

=== numeric_field_order_from_formatted + fallback_date_order + js path ===
fn numeric_field_order_from_formatted(formatted: &str) -> Option<DateOrder> {
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    enum DateComponent {
        Month,
        Day,
        Year,
    }

    // Transliterate native decimal digits (e.g. Extended Arabic-Indic for
    // `fa-IR`, Arabic-Indic for `ar-EG`) to ASCII so the probe's year/month/day
    // values are recognised regardless of the locale's numbering system.
    let formatted = crate::number::normalize_digits(formatted);

    let mut numeric_runs = Vec::new();

    let mut current: Option<u32> = None;

    for ch in formatted.chars() {
        if let Some(digit) = ch.to_digit(10) {
            current = Some(current.unwrap_or(0).checked_mul(10)?.checked_add(digit)?);
        } else if let Some(value) = current.take() {
            numeric_runs.push(value);
        }
    }

    if let Some(value) = current {
        numeric_runs.push(value);
    }

    let components: Vec<_> = numeric_runs
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|value| match value {
            11 => Some(DateComponent::Month),
            22 => Some(DateComponent::Day),
            6 | 2006 => Some(DateComponent::Year),
            _ => None,
        })
        .collect();

    match components.as_slice() {
        [
            DateComponent::Month,
            DateComponent::Day,
            DateComponent::Year,
        ] => Some(DateOrder::MonthDayYear),

        [
            DateComponent::Day,
            DateComponent::Month,
            DateComponent::Year,
        ] => Some(DateOrder::DayMonthYear),

        [
            DateComponent::Year,
            DateComponent::Month,
            DateComponent::Day,
        ] => Some(DateOrder::YearMonthDay),

        _ => None,
    }
}
```

fn fallback_date_order(locale: &Locale) -> DateOrder {
    if matches!(locale.language(), "ja" | "zh" | "ko") {
        return DateOrder::YearMonthDay;
    }

    match locale.region() {
        Some("US" | "FM" | "PW") => DateOrder::MonthDayYear,

        Some("CA" | "CN" | "HU" | "JP" | "KR" | "LT" | "MN" | "TW") => DateOrder::YearMonthDay,

        _ => DateOrder::DayMonthYear,
    }
}
    fn fallback_date_order_covers_language_and_region_branches() {
        // The `(language, region)` heuristic is the no-backend fallback (and the
        // path `date_order` takes only when the ICU/JS probe yields nothing).
        // Exercise every branch directly so it stays covered regardless of which
        // locales happen to reach it through the backend probe.
        use super::{DateOrder, fallback_date_order};

        let order = |tag: &str| fallback_date_order(&Locale::parse(tag).expect("locale parses"));

        // CJK languages are year-first regardless of region.
        assert_eq!(order("ja-JP"), DateOrder::YearMonthDay);
        assert_eq!(order("zh-CN"), DateOrder::YearMonthDay);
        assert_eq!(order("ko-KR"), DateOrder::YearMonthDay);

        // Month-first regions.
        assert_eq!(order("en-US"), DateOrder::MonthDayYear);

        // Year-first regions selected by region rather than language.
        assert_eq!(order("en-CA"), DateOrder::YearMonthDay);

        // Everything else is day-first (the most common order worldwide).
        assert_eq!(order("en-GB"), DateOrder::DayMonthYear);
        assert_eq!(order("de-DE"), DateOrder::DayMonthYear);
    }

fn js_date_order(locale: &Locale) -> Option<DateOrder> {
    let probe = CalendarDate::new_gregorian(2006, 11, 22).ok()?;

    // Force the Gregorian calendar (see `icu_date_order`): `Intl.DateTimeFormat`
    // honours the `u-ca-gregory` extension carried in the BCP-47 tag.
    let locale = locale.with_gregorian_calendar();

    let formatter = build_js_date_formatter(&locale, FormatLength::Short);

    let formatted = format_js_date(&locale, FormatLength::Short, &formatter, &probe);

    numeric_field_order_from_formatted(&formatted)
}

Digits are normalized to ASCII first (so native numbering systems are\n/// detected), leaving the inter-field separator — itself non-numeric — intact.\n/// Returns `None` when the formatted string does not contain two numeric fields.\n#[cfg(any(\n    feature = \"icu4x\",\n    all(feature = \"web-intl\", target_arch = \"wasm32\", not(feature = \"icu4x\"))\n))]\nfn separator_from_formatted(formatted: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let normalized = crate::number::normalize_digits(formatted);\n    let chars = normalized.chars().collect::<alloc::vec::Vec<_>>();\n    let len = chars.len();\n\n    let mut index = 0;\n    while index < len && !chars[index].is_ascii_digit() {\n        index += 1;\n    }\n    while index < len && chars[index].is_ascii_digit() {\n        index += 1;\n    }\n\n    let separator_start = index;\n    while index < len && !chars[index].is_ascii_digit() {\n        index += 1;\n    }\n\n    // Require a second numeric field after the separator; otherwise there is no\n    // inter-field separator to report.\n    if index >= len || separator_start == index {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    Some(chars[separator_start..index].iter().collect())\n}\n\n#[cfg(any(\n    feature = \"icu4x\",\n    all(feature = \"web-intl\", target_arch = \"wasm32\", not(feature = \"icu4x\"))\n))]\nfn numeric_field_order_from_formatted(formatted: &str) -> Option<DateOrder> {"
}

> AGENT

Done. To answer your original question: **there was no shared locale date-separator helper** — the heuristic was duplicated in three places with a ko-KR divergence. Per your "derive from CLDR" choice, I made one canonical source and routed all three through it.

## What changed for the separator

**New canonical function** — [`ars_i18n::date_field_separator(locale) -> String`](crates/ars-i18n/src/date.rs#L1322), mirroring `date_order`'s 3-tier resolution:
- **icu4x** → formats a Gregorian probe date and extracts the literal between the first two numeric fields (`separator_from_formatted`, reusing the same digit-normalization as the order probe).
- **web-intl/wasm** → same via `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.
- **fallback** → `(language, region)` heuristic (`de-DE` → `.`, `ko-KR` → `. `, else `/`), a superset matching both old per-component heuristics.
- Re-exported from `ars-i18n` lib; 3 new tests (fallback branches, ICU literal, parser).

**Call sites now derive from it:**
- DateTimePicker — removed my local `date_separator`; `build_date_segments` + `format_announcement` use the shared fn.
- DateField — `literal_for_locale` deleted; `SegmentPatternPart::Literal` converted from `&'static str` to `String` to carry CLDR literals.
- DatePicker — its single-char pattern model takes the first char of the shared separator (`ko-KR`'s `. ` → `.`), removing its inline heuristic.
- Specs (`date-picker`, `date-field`, `date-time-picker`) updated to cite the shared source.

## Why it's low-risk

Components build without `icu4x` by default, so default-feature snapshots use the **fallback**, which reproduces the exact old per-component values for every tested locale (en-US/en-GB/ja-JP/de-DE identical; ko-KR was untested). CLDR only enriches the `i18n`/adapter path.

> AGENT

The two independently-built `Messages` hold distinct `Arc` closures, so `MessageFn` equality (pointer-based) makes fresh services never equal — the same as the old chain. The correct test clones one context (shared `Arc`):

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01QjotsuJ7x125AkxRNNE9vX
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-292/crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/tests.rs",
  "old_string": "#[test]\nfn context_equality_compares_all_fields() {\n    let left = service();\n    let right = service();\n    assert_eq!(left.context(), right.context());\n\n    let mut changed = service();\n    drop(changed.send(Event::FocusSegment(DateSegmentKind::Month)));\n    assert_ne!(left.context(), changed.context());\n}",
  "new_string": "#[test]\nfn context_equality_compares_all_fields() {\n    // Clone shares the message closures' `Arc`s, so an unmodified clone compares\n    // equal; a state change makes the live context differ.\n    let mut svc = service();\n    let snapshot = svc.context().clone();\n\n    // `Close` while idle is a no-op, leaving the context untouched.\n    drop(svc.send(Event::Close));\n    assert_eq!(&snapshot, svc.context());\n\n    drop(svc.send(Event::FocusSegment(DateSegmentKind::Month)));\n    assert_ne!(&snapshot, svc.context());\n}"
}
```

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalP
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:725  (reply_to=3338777205)
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use the selected calendar when assembling dates**

When `calendar` is anything other than Gregorian, segment edits still rebuild `CalendarDate` with `CalendarDate::new_gregorian`, so a user editing Buddhist/Japanese/etc. year/month/day segments commits a Gregorian date with the same display fields instead of the configured calendar date. This diverges from the component's `calendar` prop and from `date_field`, which assembles through `CalendarDate::new(self.calendar, ...)`, so non-Gregorian DateTimePicker values become chronologically wrong after any segment edit or type-ahead publish.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalS
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:2354  (reply_to=3338777210)
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Format hidden inputs from canonical ISO dates**

For non-Gregorian selected values, this hidden-input formatter serializes the calendar display fields (`date.year()/month()/day()`) rather than the canonical ISO slots exposed by `CalendarDate::to_iso8601()`. A Buddhist date equivalent to 2024-03-15 would submit the Buddhist display year, so form submission no longer carries the ISO 8601 datetime promised by the spec and by the function comment.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalT
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:1656  (reply_to=3338777211)
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable the trigger in readonly mode**

When `Props::readonly(true)`, the trigger remains enabled and tabbable because this branch only handles `disabled`. The state machine later drops `Toggle`/`Open`, but users and assistive tech still encounter an operable-looking button that does nothing, while the component contract says readonly should disable the trigger just like the clear button.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalU
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:1637  (reply_to=3338777213)
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Set the trigger button type**

When a DateTimePicker is rendered inside a form, this trigger is a `<button>` without an explicit `type`, so browsers treat it as a submit button. Clicking the calendar trigger or pressing Enter/Space on it can submit the surrounding form instead of only opening the popover; the sibling DatePicker explicitly sets `type="button"` to avoid this.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalW
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:1670  (reply_to=3338777215)
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Set the clear button type**

When the clear trigger is visible inside a form, it is also emitted as a `<button>` without `type="button"`, so activating it can submit the form while clearing the value. This is especially surprising for a destructive/auxiliary control, and DatePicker's clear trigger already avoids the default submit behavior by setting the button type explicitly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

═══ THREAD PRRT_kwDORp4enM6GUalZ
file: crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_time_picker/mod.rs:1047  (reply_to=3338777219)
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject out-of-range calendar selections**

If a stale/scripted embedded-calendar event selects a date outside `min_value`/`max_value` while the time segments are still incomplete, this path stores that date and rebuilds the visible segments before `maybe_publish` can clamp anything. DatePicker defensively rejects out-of-range calendar selections for the same stale-event case; without the same guard here, the DateTimePicker can display and forward an impossible selected date until the user completes the time.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

  "new_string": "            Event::CalendarSelectDate(date) => {\n                if ctx.readonly {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                // Defense-in-depth: reject a date the picker disallows. The\n                // embedded calendar should never offer an out-of-range date, but\n                // a stale/scripted `CalendarSelectDate` must not store and display\n                // an impossible date before the time segments complete and\n                // `maybe_publish` could clamp. Compare the date against the\n                // date portion of the min/max bounds.\n                let in_range = ctx\n                    .min_value\n                    .as_ref()\n                    .is_none_or(|min| date.compare(min.date()) != Ordering::Less)\n                    && ctx\n                        .max_value\n                        .as_ref()\n                        .is_none_or(|max| date.compare(max.date()) != Ordering::Greater);\n                if !in_range {\n                    return None;\n                }\n\n                let date = date.clone();"
}

  "new_string": "    /// Assemble a `CalendarDate` from current date segment values, using the\n    /// configured `calendar` system (matching `date_field`) so non-Gregorian\n    /// values commit dates in that calendar rather than a Gregorian look-alike.\n    pub fn assemble_date(&self) -> Option<CalendarDate> {\n        let year = self.segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Year)?;\n        let month = u8::try_from(self.segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Month)?).ok()?;\n        let day = u8::try_from(self.segment_value(DateSegmentKind::Day)?).ok()?;\n        CalendarDate::new(self.calendar, &CalendarDateFields {\n            year: Some(year), month: Some(month), day: Some(day), ..CalendarDateFields::default()\n        }).ok()\n    }"
}
